30template <typename CommType>
31TMC9660<CommType>::TMC9660(CommType& comm, uint8_t address,
32 const BootloaderConfig* boot_cfg) noexcept
33 : comm_(comm), address_(address & 0x7F), bootCfg_(boot_cfg) {
34 // Auto-derive feature topology from the bootloader configuration when one was
35 // provided. This converts later "REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE" silicon errors on
36 // SPI-encoder / Step-Dir paths into clear host-side ERROR logs at the API
37 // boundary. Y2 phase has no bootloader switch (it's a board topology fact),
38 // so it stays at the default true — boards without Y2 wired should call
39 // setCapabilities({.y2Phase=false, ...}) immediately after construction.
40 if (boot_cfg != nullptr) {
41 caps_.spiEncoder = boot_cfg->spiEnc.enable;
42 caps_.stepDir = boot_cfg->stepDir.enable;
43 }
44 // Initialize bootloader for SPI and UART interfaces
45 if (comm.mode() == CommMode::SPI || comm.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
46 bootloader_ = std::make_unique<TMC9660Bootloader<CommType>>(comm);
47 }
48}

103template <typename CommType>
104typename TMC9660<CommType>::BootloaderInitResult TMC9660<CommType>::bootloaderInit(const BootloaderConfig* cfg,
105 bool perform_reset,
106 bool retrieve_bootloader_info,
107 bool fail_on_verify_error) noexcept {
108 const BootloaderConfig* useCfg = cfg ? cfg : bootCfg_;
109 if (!useCfg)
110 return BootloaderInitResult::NoConfig;
111 if (!bootloader_) {
112 // Bootloader only works with SPI/UART interface
113 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
114 }
115
116 TMCLFrame statusFrame{};
117 statusFrame.opcode =
118 static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetStatusScript); // GetStatusScript command
119
120 // ======================================================================
121 // STEP 1: Hardware Reset Sequence (if requested)
122 // ======================================================================
123 if (perform_reset) {
124 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Performing hardware reset sequence...");
125
126 // 1.1: Assert RST (active high) to enter reset state
127 if (!comm_.gpioSetActive(TMC9660CtrlPin::RST)) {
128 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to assert RST pin");
129 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
130 }
131 comm_.delayMs(10); // Hold reset for 10ms
132
133 // 1.2: Release RST to exit reset state
134 if (!comm_.gpioSetInactive(TMC9660CtrlPin::RST)) {
135 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to release RST pin");
136 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
137 }
138
139 // 1.3: Wait for FAULTN to go inactive (chip ready)
140 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "Waiting for FAULTN to go inactive (chip ready)...");
141 bool chip_ready = false;
142 for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) { // Timeout after 1 second
143 GpioSignal faultnSignal;
144 if (!comm_.gpioRead(TMC9660CtrlPin::FAULTN, faultnSignal)) {
145 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Failed to read FAULTN pin - continuing anyway");
146 break; // Don't fail, just continue without FAULTN monitoring
147 }
148
149 // FAULTN is active-low, so INACTIVE means chip is ready
150 if (faultnSignal == GpioSignal::INACTIVE) {
151 chip_ready = true;
152 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ FAULTN inactive - chip ready after %d ms",
153 i * 10);
154 break;
155 }
156 comm_.delayMs(10);
157 }
158
159 if (!chip_ready) {
160 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
161 "⚠️ FAULTN did not go inactive within timeout - continuing anyway");
162 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
163 " (FAULTN may not be configured or chip may be in different state)");
164 }
165
166 // Small delay for chip to fully stabilize in bootloader
167 comm_.delayMs(50);
168 } else {
169 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Skipping hardware reset (perform_reset=false)");
170 }
171
172 // ======================================================================
173 // STEP 2: Detect Current Mode (Bootloader vs Parameter Mode)
174 // ======================================================================
175 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Detecting chip mode (bootloader vs parameter)...");
176
177 // Additional delay for UART communication to stabilize after reset
178 // UART requires more setup time than SPI
179 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
180 comm_.delayMs(100);
181 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "UART mode: Added 100ms stabilization delay");
182 }
183
184 bool in_bootloader_mode = false;
185 bool in_parameter_mode = false;
186
187 TMCLReply firstReply{}, finalReply{};
188 bool tmclSuccess = comm_.transferTMCL(statusFrame, finalReply, address_, &firstReply, nullptr);
189
190 uint8_t raw_status = firstReply.rawBytes[0];
191 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "First reply raw status: 0x%02X (TMCL parse %s)",
192 raw_status, tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
193
194 // For UART: If TMCL transfer completely failed (no response), chip is likely in bootloader mode
195 // For SPI: Always get a response due to full-duplex nature, check status codes
196 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART && !tmclSuccess) {
197 in_bootloader_mode = true;
198 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (UART: no TMCL response)");
199 } else if (raw_status == 0x13) {
200 in_bootloader_mode = true;
201 uint32_t version = firstReply.extractRawValue(1);
202 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
203 "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (SESSION_START), version: %d.%d",
204 (version >> 16) & 0xFFFF, version & 0xFFFF);
205 } else if (raw_status == 0x0C) {
206 in_parameter_mode = true;
207 uint32_t version = tmclSuccess ? firstReply.value : firstReply.extractRawValue(1);
208 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in PARAMETER mode (FIRST_CMD), version: %d.%d",
209 (version >> 16) & 0xFFFF, version & 0xFFFF);
210 } else if (raw_status == 0xFF && tmclSuccess &&
211 (firstReply.status == 100 || firstReply.status == 101)) {
212 in_parameter_mode = true;
213 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in PARAMETER mode (initialized)");
214 } else if (raw_status == 0x00 && comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
215 // For SPI: 0x00 can indicate bootloader OK status
216 in_bootloader_mode = true;
217 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Chip in BOOTLOADER mode (SPI: OK status 0x00)");
218 } else if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
219 /* Undriven / pull-up MISO often reads 0xFF. UART already treats “no TMCL”
220 * as a bootloader probe; do the same on SPI so applyConfiguration / NO_OP
221 * can continue instead of hard-failing mode detect. */
222 in_bootloader_mode = true;
223 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
224 "SPI mode unknown (status 0x%02X, TMCL %s) — trying bootloader path",
225 raw_status, tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
226 } else {
227 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
228 "Unable to detect chip mode (unknown status: 0x%02X, TMCL %s)", raw_status,
229 tmclSuccess ? "succeeded" : "failed");
230 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
231 }
232
233 // ======================================================================
234 // STEP 3: Handle Parameter Mode Scenarios
235 // ======================================================================
236 if (in_parameter_mode && !in_bootloader_mode) {
237 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
238 "Chip in parameter mode, transitioning to bootloader...");
239
240 // Send Boot command to enter bootloader
241 if (!enterBootloaderMode()) {
242 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to send Boot command");
243 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
244 }
245
246 // Wait for transition to complete
247 comm_.delayMs(150);
248
249 // Verify we're now in bootloader mode
250 uint32_t reply_after_boot = 0;
251 if (!bootloader_->noOp(&reply_after_boot)) {
252 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to verify bootloader mode after Boot command");
253 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
254 }
255
256 uint8_t statusAfterBoot = static_cast<uint8_t>((reply_after_boot >> 24) & 0xFF);
257 if (statusAfterBoot != 0x15) { // BOOTLOADER_RESUMED status
258 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Expected BOOTLOADER_RESUMED (0x15), got 0x%02X",
259 statusAfterBoot);
260 } else {
261 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Successfully entered bootloader mode");
262 }
263
264 in_bootloader_mode = true;
265 }
266
267 // ======================================================================
268 // STEP 4: Apply Configuration via Bootloader
269 // ======================================================================
270 if (in_bootloader_mode || !in_parameter_mode) {
271
272 // ======================================================================
273 // STEP 4.5: Retrieve Bootloader Information (if requested)
274 // ======================================================================
275 if (retrieve_bootloader_info) {
276 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Retrieving bootloader information...");
277 if (!bootloader_->getAllBootloaderInfo()) {
278 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Failed to retrieve some bootloader information");
279 }
280 } else {
281 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
282 "Skipping bootloader information retrieval (retrieve_bootloader_info=false)");
283 }
284
285 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Applying bootloader configuration...");
286 if (!bootloader_->applyConfiguration(*useCfg, fail_on_verify_error)) {
287 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "Failed to apply bootloader configuration");
288 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
289 }
290 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Bootloader configuration applied successfully");
291 }
292
293 // ======================================================================
294 // STEP 5: Check if motor control should be started
295 // ======================================================================
296 if (!useCfg->boot.start_motor_control) {
297 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
298 "✅ Bootloader initialization complete (motor control NOT started)");
299 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
300 " cfg.boot.start_motor_control=false - chip remains in bootloader mode");
301 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", " Call bootloader_->startMotorControl() when ready");
302 return BootloaderInitResult::Success;
303 }
304
305 // Motor control will be started automatically by Bootloader after applyConfiguration() when
306 // cfg.boot.start_motor_control=true is written to the boot config register
307 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Bootloader initialization complete");
308 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
309 " Motor control started automatically via cfg.boot.start_motor_control=true");
310
311 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Waiting for initialization...");
312 comm_.delayMs(100);
313
314 // ======================================================================
315 // STEP 7: Wait for Motor Control Initialization and Verify Communication
316 // ======================================================================
317 // For SPI: Consume SESSION_START and wait for SPI_STATUS_OK
318 // For UART: Simply verify TMCL communication works (no status codes)
319
320 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::SPI) {
321 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
322 "SPI mode: Waiting for SESSION_START and consuming status codes...");
323
324 // Poll for chip readiness and SESSION_START (SPI-specific)
325 bool session_start_received = false;
326 for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 50; ++attempt) { // Timeout after 5 seconds (50 * 100ms)
327 TMCLReply firstReply2{}, finalReply2{};
328 comm_.transferTMCL(statusFrame, finalReply2, address_, &firstReply2, nullptr);
329
330 uint8_t rawStatus2 = finalReply2.rawBytes[0]; // Check the reply to the CURRENT command
331 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "Attempt %d/50: Current reply raw status: 0x%02X",
332 attempt + 1, rawStatus2);
333
334 if (rawStatus2 == 0x0C) {
335 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
336 "✅ Parameter mode SESSION_START (0x0C) received after %d attempts",
337 attempt + 1);
338 session_start_received = true;
339 break;
340 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0xFF) {
341 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
342 "✅ SPI_STATUS_OK (0xFF) received after %d attempts - chip ready",
343 attempt + 1);
344 session_start_received = true;
345 break;
346 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0xF0) {
347 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660", "SPI_STATUS_NOT_READY (0xF0) - waiting...");
348 comm_.delayMs(100);
349 continue;
350 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0x13) {
351 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
352 "⚠️ Still in bootloader mode (0x13) - motor control not ready yet");
353 comm_.delayMs(100);
354 continue;
355 } else if (rawStatus2 == 0x00) {
356 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
357 "⚠️ Bootloader OK (0x00) - motor control not ready yet");
358 comm_.delayMs(100);
359 continue;
360 } else {
361 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "⚠️ Unexpected status 0x%02X - waiting...",
362 rawStatus2);
363 comm_.delayMs(100);
364 continue;
365 }
366 }
367
368 if (!session_start_received) {
369 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
370 "❌ Timeout waiting for SESSION_START or SPI_STATUS_OK");
371 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control may not have started properly");
372 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
373 }
374 } else {
375 // UART mode: No SESSION_START or status codes, just wait for motor control to initialize
376 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
377 "UART mode: Waiting for motor control initialization...");
378 comm_.delayMs(100); // Give motor control time to start (adjust as needed)
379 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ Motor control initialization delay completed");
380 }
381
382 // ======================================================================
383 // STEP 8: Verify TMCL Communication with GetVersion
384 // ======================================================================
385 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Verifying TMCL communication with GetVersion...");
386
387 // First, for UART mode, let's verify we're NOT still in bootloader mode
388 if (comm_.mode() == CommMode::UART) {
389 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
390 "UART mode: Testing if chip is still in bootloader mode...");
391 tmc9660::BootloaderVersion bootloaderVer;
392 if (bootloader_->getBootloaderVersion(&bootloaderVer)) {
393 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ ERROR: Chip is STILL in bootloader mode!");
394 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Bootloader version: %d.%d", bootloaderVer.major,
395 bootloaderVer.minor);
396 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control did NOT start properly");
397 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660",
398 " Check boot configuration: cfg.boot.start_motor_control should be true");
399 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
400 } else {
401 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
402 "✅ Bootloader commands fail (good - we're in parameter mode)");
403 }
404 }
405
406 // Try a simple command first (MST - Motor Stop)
407 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Testing TMCL communication with MST (Motor Stop)...");
408 if (!sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::MST, 0, 0, 0, nullptr)) {
409 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ TMCL communication failed (MST command failed)");
410 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Motor control is not responding to TMCL commands");
411 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
412 }
413 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ MST command successful - TMCL communication working!");
414
415 // Now try GetVersion
416 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "Getting firmware version with GetVersion...");
417 uint32_t version = 0;
418 if (!sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetVersion, 0, 0, 0, &version)) {
419 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", "❌ GetVersion failed (but MST worked)");
420 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 0, "TMC9660", " Basic TMCL works, but GetVersion has issues");
421 return BootloaderInitResult::Failure;
422 }
423
424 // GetVersion success is already logged in sendCommand() with the version string
425 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ TMCL communication verified - GetVersion successful");
426 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
427 "✅ Chip fully initialized and ready for motor control commands");
428
429 return BootloaderInitResult::Success;
430}

543template <typename CommType>
544bool TMC9660<CommType>::sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op opcode, uint16_t type, uint8_t motor, uint32_t value,
545 uint32_t* reply, tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode* out_tmcl_status) noexcept {
546 TMCLFrame tx{};
547 tx.opcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(opcode);
548 tx.type = type;
549 tx.motor = motor;
550 tx.value = value;
551
552 // Debug logging for TMCL frame assembly
553 const char* opName = tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(tx.opcode));
554
555 // Format type field based on the operation type
556 char typeStr[80];
557 switch (tx.opcode) {
558 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SAP): // Set Axis Parameter
559 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GAP): // Get Axis Parameter
560 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::AAP): // Accumulator to Axis Parameter
561 {
562 const char* paramName =
563 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters>(tx.type));
564 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "%s (0x%04X, %u)", paramName, tx.type, tx.type);
565 } break;
566 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SGP): // Set Global Parameter
567 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GGP): // Get Global Parameter
568 case static_cast<uint8_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::AGP): // Accumulator to Global Parameter
569 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "GlobalParam=0x%04X", tx.type);
570 break;
571 default:
572 snprintf(typeStr, sizeof(typeStr), "0x%04X", tx.type);
573 break;
574 }
575
576 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 3, "TMC9660",
577 "[TMCL TX] %s (Op=0x%02X), Type=%s, Motor=0x%02X, Value=0x%08X", opName,
578 tx.opcode, typeStr, tx.motor, tx.value);
579
580 TMCLReply rep{};
581 if (!comm_.transferTMCL(tx, rep, address_, nullptr, nullptr)) {
582 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660", "[TMCL] Transfer failed");
583 if (out_tmcl_status)
584 *out_tmcl_status = tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode::REPLY_CHKERR;
585 return false;
586 }
587 if (out_tmcl_status)
588 *out_tmcl_status = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status);
589
590 // Debug logging for TMCL reply with decoded status and opcode
591 // Note: SPI response format: byte0=SPI_STATUS, byte1=TMCL_STATUS, byte2=OPCODE, byte3-6=VALUE,
592 // byte7=CHECKSUM
593 const char* statusName =
594 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status));
595 const char* rxOpName = tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(rep.opcode));
596 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(
597 comm_, 3, "TMC9660",
598 "[TMCL RX] %s (SPI_Status=0x%02X, TMCL_Status=0x%02X), Op=%s (0x%02X), Value=0x%08X",
599 statusName, static_cast<uint8_t>(rep.spi_status), rep.status, rxOpName, rep.opcode, rep.value);
600
601 // Special handling for GetVersion command (Type=0 returns string format)
602 if (opcode == tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GetVersion && type == 0) {
603 std::string versionString = rep.getVersionString();
604 if (!versionString.empty()) {
605 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "✅ GetVersion successful - Firmware version: %s",
606 versionString.c_str());
607 if (reply)
608 *reply = 0; // No numeric value for string format
609 return true;
610 } else {
611 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 1, "TMC9660",
612 "⚠️ GetVersion string format not detected, trying standard parsing");
613 }
614 }
615
616 if (!rep.isOK()) {
617 // Distinguish between SPI communication failure and TMCL command failure
618 if (rep.spi_status == SPIStatus::OK) {
619 // SPI communication successful, but TMCL command failed
620 const char* tmclStatusName =
621 tmc9660::tmcl::to_string(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::ReplyCode>(rep.status));
622 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660", "[TMCL] Command failed: %s (TMCL_Status=0x%02X)",
623 tmclStatusName, rep.status);
624 } else {
625 // SPI communication failure
626 const char* spiStatusStr = "UNKNOWN";
627 switch (rep.spi_status) {
628 case SPIStatus::CHECKSUM_ERROR:
629 spiStatusStr = "CHECKSUM_ERROR";
630 break;
631 case SPIStatus::NOT_READY:
632 spiStatusStr = "NOT_READY";
633 break;
634 case SPIStatus::FIRST_CMD:
635 spiStatusStr = "FIRST_CMD";
636 break;
637 default:
638 spiStatusStr = "UNKNOWN";
639 break;
640 }
641 TMC9660_LOG_DEBUG(comm_, 2, "TMC9660",
642 "[TMCL] SPI communication failed: %s (SPI_Status=0x%02X)", spiStatusStr,
643 static_cast<uint8_t>(rep.spi_status));
644 }
645 return false;
646 }
647 if (reply)
648 *reply = rep.value;
649 return true;
650}

719template <typename CommType>
720bool TMC9660<CommType>::MotorConfig::configureAuto(const MotorProfile& profile) noexcept {
721 bool ok = true;
722
723 // --- Safety Check: Ensure critical parameters are valid ---
724 if (profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A <= 0.0f || profile.pwmFrequency_Hz < 10000 ||
725 profile.pwmFrequency_Hz > 100000 ||
726 (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR && profile.polePairs == 0) ||
727 (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::STEPPER_MOTOR && profile.polePairs == 0)) {
728 return false;
729 }
730
731 // Step 1: Set commutation mode to SYSTEM_OFF (required before changing motor type)
732 ok &= setCommutationMode(tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode::SYSTEM_OFF);
733
734 // Step 2: Set motor type and pole pairs
735 ok &= setType(profile.motorType, profile.polePairs);
736
737 // Step 3: Set motor direction
738 ok &= setDirection(profile.direction);
739
740 // Step 4: Set PWM frequency
741 ok &= setPWMFrequency(profile.pwmFrequency_Hz);
742
743 // Step 5: Set PWM switching scheme (with smart defaults based on motor type)
744 tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme pwmScheme = profile.pwmSwitchingScheme;
745 // Auto-select default based on motor type if SVPWM is set for non-BLDC motors
746 if (profile.motorType != tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR &&
747 pwmScheme == tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme::SVPWM) {
748 // SVPWM is only valid for BLDC motors, use STANDARD for DC/Stepper
749 pwmScheme = tmc9660::tmcl::PwmSwitchingScheme::STANDARD;
750 }
751 ok &= setPWMSwitchingScheme(pwmScheme);
752
753 // Step 6: Set idle motor PWM behavior
754 ok &= setIdleMotorPWMBehavior(profile.idlePwmBehavior);
755
756 // Step 7: Calculate and set MAX_TORQUE from max_phase_current_a
757 uint16_t maxTorque_mA = static_cast<uint16_t>(profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A * 1000.0f + 0.5f);
758 ok &= setMaxTorqueCurrent(maxTorque_mA);
759
760 // Step 8: Calculate and set MAX_FLUX
761 // For DC motors, flux is not used (but we still set it to avoid issues)
762 // For BLDC/Stepper, default to 20% of max phase current if not specified
763 float maxFlux_A = profile.maxFluxCurrent_A;
764 if (std::isnan(maxFlux_A) || maxFlux_A <= 0.0f) {
765 if (profile.motorType == tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::DC_MOTOR) {
766 maxFlux_A = 0.0f; // DC motors don't use flux
767 } else {
768 maxFlux_A = profile.maxPhaseCurrent_A * 0.2f; // 20% default for BLDC/Stepper
769 }
770 }
771 uint16_t maxFlux_mA = static_cast<uint16_t>(maxFlux_A * 1000.0f + 0.5f);
772 ok &= setMaxFluxCurrent(maxFlux_mA);
773
774 // Step 9: Set output voltage limit
775 ok &= setOutputVoltageLimit(profile.outputVoltageLimit);
776
777 // Step 10: Apply commutation mode if specified (applied last, after all configuration)
778 // This allows users to set the desired commutation mode (e.g., FOC_HALL, FOC_ENCODER)
779 // which will be applied after all motor parameters are configured
780 if (profile.commutationMode.has_value()) {
781 ok &= setCommutationMode(profile.commutationMode.value());
782 }
783
784 return ok;
785}

1046template <typename CommType>
1047bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::calibrateOffsets(bool waitForCompletion,
1048 uint32_t timeoutMs) noexcept {
1049 using tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags;
1050 using tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters;
1051 // Clear the calibrated flag to trigger a new calibration cycle
1052 if (!driver.writeParameter(
1053 Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS,
1054 static_cast<uint32_t>(GeneralStatusFlags::ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED)))
1055 return false;
1056
1057 if (!waitForCompletion)
1058 return true;
1059
1060 uint32_t elapsedMs = 0;
1061 const uint32_t pollIntervalMs = 10;
1062 bool done = false;
1063 while (elapsedMs < timeoutMs) {
1064 if (!getCalibrationStatus(done))
1065 return false;
1066 if (done)
1067 return true;
1068 driver.comm_.delayMs(pollIntervalMs);
1069 elapsedMs += pollIntervalMs;
1070 }
1071 return false;
1072}
1073
1074template <typename CommType>
1075bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::getCalibrationStatus(bool& isCalibrated) noexcept {
1076 uint32_t flags;
1077 if (!driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS, flags))
1078 return false;
1079 isCalibrated =
1080 (flags & static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED)) !=
1081 0;
1082 return true;
1083}
1084
1085template <typename CommType>
1086bool TMC9660<CommType>::CurrentSensing::configureAuto(const AutoConfig& config) noexcept {
1087 // Convert mΩ to Ω
1088 const float R_shunt_Ohm = config.shuntResistance_mOhm / 1000.0f;
1089
1090 // Available CSA gains and their numeric values
1091 struct CsaGainOption {
1092 tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain gain;
1093 float numericGain;
1094 };
1095
1096 // Search HIGHEST→LOWEST gain so we pick the largest gain that still has
1097 // sufficient full-scale headroom. Higher gain ⇒ lower I_FS but proportionally
1098 // better ADC resolution per ampere (CURRENT_SCALING_FACTOR scales 1/G).
1099 // For low-current motors (e.g. 30 W BLDC drawing tens of mA in steady state)
1100 // this can be 8× better resolution than the legacy "lowest qualifying gain"
1101 // strategy and is standard practice for shunt-based sensorless drives.
1102 const CsaGainOption availableGains[] = {
1103 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_40X, 40.0f},
1104 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_20X, 20.0f},
1105 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_10X, 10.0f},
1106 {tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_5X, 5.0f},
1107 };
1108
1109 // Calculate full-scale current for each gain: I_FS = 2.5V / (G_CSA * R_shunt)
1110 // We want I_FS to be at least 1.5x the expected peak current for headroom
1111 const float minHeadroom = 1.5f;
1112 const float targetIFS = config.expectedPeakCurrent_A * minHeadroom;
1113
1114 // Find the best CSA gain — the HIGHEST gain whose full-scale current still
1115 // exceeds the headroom target (best resolution without saturating).
1116 // Fallback: if none qualify (e.g. very high peak current), keep GAIN_5X
1117 // which has the largest I_FS.
1118 tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain selectedGain = tmc9660::tmcl::CsaGain::GAIN_5X;
1119 float selectedGainValue = 5.0f;
1120 bool foundSuitableGain = false;
1121
1122 for (const auto& option : availableGains) {
1123 const float I_FS = 2.5f / (option.numericGain * R_shunt_Ohm);
1124 if (I_FS >= targetIFS && !foundSuitableGain) {
1125 selectedGain = option.gain;
1126 selectedGainValue = option.numericGain;
1127 foundSuitableGain = true;
1128 }
1129 }
1130
1131 // Calculate CURRENT_SCALING_FACTOR
1132 // Formula: Factor = 39.06 / (G_CSA * R_shunt_Ohm) for PEAK
1133 // Factor = 27.62 / (G_CSA * R_shunt_Ohm) for RMS
1134 const float scaling_factor = config.usePeakScaling ? (39.06f / (selectedGainValue * R_shunt_Ohm))
1135 : (27.62f / (selectedGainValue * R_shunt_Ohm));
1136
1137 // Clamp to valid range [1, 65535]
1138 uint16_t scalingFactorInt;
1139 if (scaling_factor < 1.0f) {
1140 scalingFactorInt = 1;
1141 } else if (scaling_factor > 65535.0f) {
1142 scalingFactorInt = 65535;
1143 } else {
1144 scalingFactorInt = static_cast<uint16_t>(scaling_factor + 0.5f); // Round to nearest
1145 }
1146
1147 // Configure all parameters
1148 bool ok = true;
1149
1150 // 1. Set shunt type
1151 ok &= setShuntType(config.shuntType);
1152
1153 // 2. Set CSA gain
1154 ok &= setCSAGain(selectedGain, selectedGain);
1155
1156 // 3. Set CSA filter
1157 ok &= setCSAFilter(config.csaFilter, config.csaFilter);
1158
1159 // 4. Set current scaling factor (this is the key parameter!)
1160 ok &= setScalingFactor(scalingFactorInt);
1161
1162 // 5. Set phase ADC mapping (use defaults if not specified: U->I0, V->I1, W->I2, Y2->I3)
1163 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapU =
1164 config.phaseU_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I0);
1165 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapV =
1166 config.phaseV_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I1);
1167 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapW =
1168 config.phaseW_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I2);
1169 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping mapY2 =
1170 config.phaseY2_adcMapping.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::AdcMapping::ADC_I3);
1171 ok &= setPhaseAdcMapping(mapU, mapV, mapW, mapY2);
1172
1173 // 6. Calculate and set individual ADC scaling factors based on actual shunt resistances
1174 // ADC_Ix_SCALE compensates for physical mismatch in shunt resistors and CSA amplifier tolerances.
1175 // Formula: ADC_Ix_SCALE = 1024 * (R_nominal / R_actual)
1176 // If actual resistance is not provided (NaN or <= 0), use nominal value (no compensation).
1177 constexpr float defaultScale = 1024.0f;
1178 constexpr float minScale = 1.0f;
1179 constexpr float maxScale = 32767.0f;
1180
1181 auto calculateScale = [&config, defaultScale, minScale,
1182 maxScale](float actualR_mOhm) -> uint16_t {
1183 // Normalize: use nominal if not provided or invalid
1184 if (std::isnan(actualR_mOhm) || actualR_mOhm <= 0.0f) {
1185 actualR_mOhm = config.shuntResistance_mOhm;
1186 }
1187
1188 // Calculate and clamp in one step
1189 float scale = defaultScale * (config.shuntResistance_mOhm / actualR_mOhm);
1190 if (scale < minScale)
1191 scale = minScale;
1192 else if (scale > maxScale)
1193 scale = maxScale;
1194
1195 return static_cast<uint16_t>(scale + 0.5f);
1196 };
1197
1198 uint16_t scale0 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc0_mOhm); // ADC_I0
1199 uint16_t scale1 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc1_mOhm); // ADC_I1
1200 uint16_t scale2 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc2_mOhm); // ADC_I2
1201 uint16_t scale3 = calculateScale(config.actualShuntR_adc3_mOhm); // ADC_I3
1202
1203 ok &= setScalingFactors(scale0, scale1, scale2, scale3);
1204
1205 // 7. Set ADC inversion (use Table 24 defaults if not specified, allow override)
1206 // Table 24: Standard ADC inversion table for usage with internal CSA
1207 // DC: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Not inverted
1208 // BLDC: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Inverted, ADC_I2=Inverted
1209 // Stepper: ADC_I0=Inverted, ADC_I1=Not inverted, ADC_I2=Inverted, ADC_I3=Not inverted
1210 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv0_default, inv1_default, inv2_default, inv3_default;
1211 switch (config.motorType) {
1212 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::DC_MOTOR:
1213 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1214 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1215 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (not used for DC)
1216 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (not used for DC)
1217 break;
1218 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR:
1219 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1220 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1221 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (WY1)
1222 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (Y2, not used for BLDC)
1223 break;
1224 case tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::STEPPER_MOTOR:
1225 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I0 (UX1)
1226 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I1 (VX2)
1227 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED; // ADC_I2 (WY1)
1228 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED; // ADC_I3 (Y2)
1229 break;
1230 default:
1231 // NO_MOTOR or unknown: use BLDC defaults as safe fallback
1232 inv0_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1233 inv1_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1234 inv2_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::INVERTED;
1235 inv3_default = tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion::NOT_INVERTED;
1236 break;
1237 }
1238
1239 // Use user-specified inversion if provided, otherwise use defaults
1240 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv0 = config.adc0_inverted.value_or(inv0_default);
1241 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv1 = config.adc1_inverted.value_or(inv1_default);
1242 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv2 = config.adc2_inverted.value_or(inv2_default);
1243 tmc9660::tmcl::AdcInversion inv3 = config.adc3_inverted.value_or(inv3_default);
1244 ok &= setInversion(inv0, inv1, inv2, inv3);
1245
1246 // 8. Optionally calibrate ADC offsets
1247 // Note: Offsets are not set manually - they are calibrated by the TMC9660 hardware.
1248 // The calibration requires the motor to be stationary and commutation to be off (SYSTEM_OFF).
1249 if (config.autoCalibrate) {
1250 // Trigger calibration and wait for completion
1251 if (!calibrateOffsets(true, config.calibrationTimeoutMs)) {
1252 return false; // Calibration failed or timed out
1253 }
1254
1255 // Verify calibration was successful by checking the ADC_OFFSET_CALIBRATED flag
1256 bool isCalibrated = false;
1257 if (!getCalibrationStatus(isCalibrated)) {
1258 return false; // Failed to read calibration status
1259 }
1260 if (!isCalibrated) {
1261 return false; // Calibration did not complete successfully
1262 }
1263 }
1264
1265 return ok;
1266}

1298template <typename CommType>
1299bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming_ns(float lowSideUVW_ns,
1300 float highSideUVW_ns,
1301 float lowSideY2_ns,
1302 float highSideY2_ns) noexcept {
1303 // Conversion formula: value = time_ns / 8.33
1304 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1305 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f;
1306
1307 auto convertToRegister = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1308 float value = time_ns / ns_per_step;
1309 // Clamp to valid range
1310 if (value < 0.0f) {
1311 return 0;
1312 }
1313 if (value > 255.0f) {
1314 return 255;
1315 }
1316 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f); // Round to nearest integer
1317 };
1318
1319 uint8_t lowUVW = convertToRegister(lowSideUVW_ns);
1320 uint8_t highUVW = convertToRegister(highSideUVW_ns);
1321 uint8_t lowY2 = convertToRegister(lowSideY2_ns);
1322 uint8_t highY2 = convertToRegister(highSideY2_ns);
1323
1324 return configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming(lowUVW, highUVW, lowY2, highY2);
1325}

1348template <typename CommType>
1349bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configureDriveTimes_ns(float sinkTimeUVW_ns, float sourceTimeUVW_ns,
1350 float sinkTimeY2_ns,
1351 float sourceTimeY2_ns) noexcept {
1352 // Conversion formula per TMC9660 documentation:
1353 // t = (1s / 120MHz) × (2 × DRIVE_TIME_xxx + 3)
1354 // Solving for register value: DRIVE_TIME = ((t × 120MHz) - 3) / 2
1355 // Where: 1s / 120MHz = 8.33ns per step
1356 // Formula: value = ((desired_time_ns / 8.33) - 3) / 2
1357 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1358 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f; // 1s / 120MHz
1359
1360 auto convertToRegister = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1361 // Convert nanoseconds to register value using TMC9660 formula:
1362 // t = 8.33ns × (2 × REG + 3) → REG = ((t / 8.33) - 3) / 2
1363 float value = ((time_ns / ns_per_step) - 3.0f) / 2.0f;
1364 // Clamp to valid range [0, 255]
1365 if (value < 0.0f) {
1366 return 0;
1367 }
1368 if (value > 255.0f) {
1369 return 255;
1370 }
1371 // Round to nearest integer (e.g., 10.5 → 11, 10.4 → 10)
1372 // This selects the register value that produces the closest actual time
1373 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1374 };
1375
1376 uint8_t sinkUVW = convertToRegister(sinkTimeUVW_ns);
1377 uint8_t sourceUVW = convertToRegister(sourceTimeUVW_ns);
1378 uint8_t sinkY2 = convertToRegister(sinkTimeY2_ns);
1379 uint8_t sourceY2 = convertToRegister(sourceTimeY2_ns);
1380
1381 return configureDriveTimes(sinkUVW, sourceUVW, sinkY2, sourceY2);
1382}

1581
1599inline float calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA(float gateCharge_nC, float pwmFreq_Hz) noexcept {
1600 constexpr float N_HIGH_SIDE_PHASES = 3.0f; // UVW phases (3 high-side FETs)
1601 constexpr float AVG_DUTY_CYCLE = 0.5f; // Average duty cycle assumption
1602 constexpr float SAFETY_MARGIN = 2.5f; // 2.5x margin for duty peaks and losses
1603
1604 // Average current needed: I = (Qg × N_phases × f_PWM) / duty_cycle
1605 // Convert nC to C, Hz to 1/s: (nC × 1e-9) × N × f_PWM / duty = A
1606 // Then convert to mA and apply safety margin
1607 float chargePerCycle_C = gateCharge_nC * 1e-9f; // Convert nC to C
1608 float avgCurrent_A = (chargePerCycle_C * N_HIGH_SIDE_PHASES * pwmFreq_Hz) / AVG_DUTY_CYCLE;
1609 return avgCurrent_A * 1000.0f * SAFETY_MARGIN; // Convert to mA and apply margin
1610}
1611
1612template <typename CommType>
1613bool TMC9660<CommType>::GateDriver::configurePowerStageProtection(const PowerStageProfile& profile) noexcept {
1614 bool ok = true;
1615 // Y2 SAPs are gated by *both* the per-call profile flag and the per-device capability flag.
1616 // The per-device flag (caps_.y2Phase) is the topology-level "is Y2 wired on this board" answer
1617 // that lets a host-side caller force-skip Y2 once at boot — useful so subsequent careless
1618 // callers can't accidentally re-enable Y2 SAPs on a 3-phase-only board.
1619 const bool cfgY2 = profile.configure_y2_phase && driver.capabilities().y2Phase;
1620
1621 // --- Safety Check: Ensure critical parameters are valid ---
1622 if (profile.busVoltage_V <= 0.0f || profile.pwmFrequency_Hz <= 0.0f ||
1623 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A <= 0.0f || profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm <= 0.0f ||
1624 profile.shuntResistance_mOhm <= 0.0f || profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC <= 0.0f) {
1625 // Log/Report error: Invalid critical input parameters
1626 return false;
1627 }
1628
1629 // ============================================================================
1630 // PART 0: GATE DRIVER INTERFACE CONFIGURATION
1631 // ============================================================================
1632 // Configure basic hardware interface settings (must be set before timing/protection)
1633
1634 // Step 0.1: Configure PWM output polarity (critical for hardware compatibility)
1635 // Wrong polarity = gate driver won't work correctly with external MOSFET stages
1636 ok &= setOutputPolarity(profile.pwmLowPolarity, profile.pwmHighPolarity);
1637
1638 // ============================================================================
1639 // PART 1: GATE DRIVER TIMING CONFIGURATION
1640 // ============================================================================
1641 // Configure MOSFET switching characteristics based on gate charge (Qg)
1642 // These directly affect switching speed and must be set before protection timing
1643
1644 // Step 1.1: Calculate gate drive times from gate charge
1645 // Target: ~200ns turn-on (source), ~135ns turn-off (sink) for efficiency/safety balance
1646 // With adaptive drive time enabled, these are maximum times; driver optimizes down
1647 // Allow user override via optional profile members for custom switching speed requirements
1648 constexpr float DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_ON_NS = 200.0f; // Default source (turn-on) time target
1649 constexpr float DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_OFF_NS = 135.0f; // Default sink (turn-off) time target
1650
1651 float targetTurnOn_ns = profile.targetTurnOnTime_ns.value_or(DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_ON_NS);
1652 float targetTurnOff_ns = profile.targetTurnOffTime_ns.value_or(DEFAULT_TARGET_TURN_OFF_NS);
1653
1654 // Validate override values are positive
1655 if (targetTurnOn_ns <= 0.0f || targetTurnOff_ns <= 0.0f) {
1656 return false; // Invalid override values
1657 }
1658
1659 // Calculate required gate currents: I = Qg / t
1660 // These are theoretical; we'll select closest available enum values
1661 float requiredSourceCurrent_mA = (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC / targetTurnOn_ns) * 1000.0f;
1662 float requiredSinkCurrent_mA = (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC / targetTurnOff_ns) * 1000.0f;
1663
1664 // Select closest available gate current enum values
1665 // Note: Selecting next-higher current results in faster switching (shorter actual rise/fall
1666 // times) This is generally safer (reduces shoot-through risk) but may increase switching losses
1667 // slightly
1668 auto selectSourceCurrent = [](float current_mA) -> tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource {
1669 if (current_mA <= 37.5f)
1670 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_25_MA;
1671 else if (current_mA <= 65.0f)
1672 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_50_MA;
1673 else if (current_mA <= 92.5f)
1674 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_80_MA;
1675 else if (current_mA <= 120.0f)
1676 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_105_MA;
1677 else if (current_mA <= 147.5f)
1678 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_135_MA;
1679 else if (current_mA <= 175.0f)
1680 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_160_MA;
1681 else if (current_mA <= 202.5f)
1682 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_190_MA;
1683 else if (current_mA <= 252.5f)
1684 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_215_MA;
1685 else if (current_mA <= 325.0f)
1686 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_290_MA;
1687 else if (current_mA <= 395.0f)
1688 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_360_MA;
1689 else if (current_mA <= 465.0f)
1690 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_430_MA;
1691 else if (current_mA <= 562.5f)
1692 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_500_MA;
1693 else if (current_mA <= 690.0f)
1694 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_625_MA;
1695 else if (current_mA <= 805.0f)
1696 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_755_MA;
1697 else
1698 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource::CUR_855_MA;
1699 };
1700
1701 auto selectSinkCurrent = [](float current_mA) -> tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink {
1702 if (current_mA <= 75.0f)
1703 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_50_MA;
1704 else if (current_mA <= 130.0f)
1705 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_100_MA;
1706 else if (current_mA <= 185.0f)
1707 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_160_MA;
1708 else if (current_mA <= 240.0f)
1709 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_210_MA;
1710 else if (current_mA <= 295.0f)
1711 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_270_MA;
1712 else if (current_mA <= 350.0f)
1713 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_320_MA;
1714 else if (current_mA <= 405.0f)
1715 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_380_MA;
1716 else if (current_mA <= 505.0f)
1717 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_430_MA;
1718 else if (current_mA <= 650.0f)
1719 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_580_MA;
1720 else if (current_mA <= 790.0f)
1721 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_720_MA;
1722 else if (current_mA <= 930.0f)
1723 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_860_MA;
1724 else if (current_mA <= 1125.0f)
1725 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1000_MA;
1726 else if (current_mA <= 1380.0f)
1727 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1250_MA;
1728 else if (current_mA <= 1640.0f)
1729 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1510_MA;
1730 else if (current_mA <= 1890.0f)
1731 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_1770_MA;
1732 else
1733 return tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink::CUR_2000_MA;
1734 };
1735
1736 tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSource sourceCurrent = selectSourceCurrent(requiredSourceCurrent_mA);
1737 tmc9660::tmcl::GateCurrentSink sinkCurrent = selectSinkCurrent(requiredSinkCurrent_mA);
1738 if (profile.uvw_gate_current_source) {
1739 sourceCurrent = *profile.uvw_gate_current_source;
1740 }
1741 if (profile.uvw_gate_current_sink) {
1742 sinkCurrent = *profile.uvw_gate_current_sink;
1743 }
1744
1745 // Step 1.2: Configure drive times (maximum times with adaptive mode)
1746 // Adaptive drive time will shorten these based on actual gate voltage monitoring
1747 if (cfgY2) {
1748 ok &= configureDriveTimes_ns(targetTurnOff_ns, targetTurnOn_ns, targetTurnOff_ns,
1749 targetTurnOn_ns);
1750 } else {
1751 constexpr float ns_per_step = 8.33f; // 1s / 120MHz
1752 auto convertDriveTimeReg = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1753 float value = ((time_ns / ns_per_step) - 3.0f) / 2.0f;
1754 if (value < 0.0f) {
1755 return 0;
1756 }
1757 if (value > 255.0f) {
1758 return 255;
1759 }
1760 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1761 };
1762 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::DRIVE_TIME_SINK_UVW,
1763 convertDriveTimeReg(targetTurnOff_ns));
1764 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::DRIVE_TIME_SOURCE_UVW,
1765 convertDriveTimeReg(targetTurnOn_ns));
1766 }
1767
1768 // Step 1.3: Enable adaptive drive time for efficiency
1769 // Adaptive mode monitors gate voltage and shortens drive times automatically
1770 if (cfgY2) {
1771 ok &= enableAdaptiveDriveTime(true, true);
1772 } else {
1773 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_UVW, 1u);
1774 }
1775
1776 // Step 1.4: Configure break-before-make timing (dead time)
1777 // Documentation recommends 0 to let driver use internal optimized timing
1778 // For special cases (high voltage, slow body diodes), dead time can be explicitly set
1779 // Default to 0 per documentation recommendation for optimal performance
1780 // Note: If overrideDeadTime_ns is added to PowerStageProfile in future, use:
1781 // float dead_time_ns = profile.overrideDeadTime_ns.value_or(0.0f);
1782 constexpr float dead_time_ns = 0.0f;
1783 if (cfgY2) {
1784 ok &= configureBreakBeforeMakeTiming_ns(dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns, dead_time_ns);
1785 } else {
1786 constexpr float ns_per_step_bbm = 8.33f;
1787 auto convertBbmReg = [](float time_ns) -> uint8_t {
1788 float value = time_ns / ns_per_step_bbm;
1789 if (value < 0.0f) {
1790 return 0;
1791 }
1792 if (value > 255.0f) {
1793 return 255;
1794 }
1795 return static_cast<uint8_t>(value + 0.5f);
1796 };
1797 const uint8_t bbm = convertBbmReg(dead_time_ns);
1798 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_LOW_UVW, bbm);
1799 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BREAK_BEFORE_MAKE_TIME_HIGH_UVW, bbm);
1800 }
1801
1802 // Gate currents (SAP 245–246): program after drive times / BBM per TMC9660 gate-driver ordering.
1803 //
1804 // FW051V100 silicon-rev-1/var-2 quirk: NR 245 (UVW_SINK_CURRENT) and NR 246
1805 // (UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT) reject every plain enum value (0..15) with REPLY_INVALID_VALUE —
1806 // both the auto-derived index AND the chip's own reset-default index — unless the host
1807 // writes the nibble-replicated form 0x111 * enum_idx, i.e. the same 4-bit code placed in
1808 // each of the three low nibbles (bits [11:8], [7:4], [3:0]). 0x111 = 0b_0001_0001_0001,
1809 // so multiplying by enum_idx ∈ [0,15] gives 0x000, 0x111, 0x222, …, 0xFFF — the full
1810 // 16-value range fits losslessly in 12 bits because each nibble independently carries
1811 // the 4-bit code. The firmware appears to decode the 12-bit word as three independent
1812 // 4-bit fields (likely one per gate-driver leg) and only accepts writes where all three
1813 // fields agree. Empirically: writing 0x444 stores 4 and GAP echoes back 4; writing plain
1814 // 4 (= 0x004, three disagreeing nibbles) returns INVALID_VALUE. Other gate-current-
1815 // related NRs (239 USE_ADAPTIVE_DRIVE_TIME_UVW, 241/242 DRIVE_TIME_*_UVW) accept the
1816 // plain form, so this is specifically a 245/246 (and by extension 247/248 Y2)
1817 // marshalling quirk on this firmware revision.
1818 //
1819 // The transform is applied unconditionally on the assumption it's harmless on
1820 // future/other firmware revisions (the chip would still see enum_idx in the low nibble).
1821 // If a future silicon rev rejects the replicated form, this can be gated via a runtime
1822 // capability flag without touching call sites.
1823 auto encodeGateCurrent = [](uint32_t enum_idx) noexcept -> uint32_t {
1824 return 0x111u * (enum_idx & 0xFu);
1825 };
1826 if (profile.program_gate_current_limits) {
1827 if (cfgY2) {
1828 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SINK_CURRENT,
1829 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
1830 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT,
1831 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
1832 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::Y2_SINK_CURRENT,
1833 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
1834 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::Y2_SOURCE_CURRENT,
1835 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
1836 } else {
1837 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SINK_CURRENT,
1838 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sinkCurrent)));
1839 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_SOURCE_CURRENT,
1840 encodeGateCurrent(static_cast<uint32_t>(sourceCurrent)));
1841 }
1842 }
1843
1844 // Step 1.5: Configure bootstrap current limit
1845 // Bootstrap must supply gate charge for high-side FETs at PWM switching rate
1846 // Uses physics-based calculation (see calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA helper function)
1847 tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit bootstrapCurrent;
1848 float bootstrapCurrent_mA =
1849 calculateBootstrapCurrent_mA(profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC, profile.pwmFrequency_Hz);
1850
1851 if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 68.0f) {
1852 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_45_MA;
1853 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 116.0f) {
1854 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_91_MA;
1855 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 166.0f) {
1856 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_141_MA;
1857 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 229.0f) {
1858 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_191_MA;
1859 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 279.5f) {
1860 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_267_MA;
1861 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 316.5f) {
1862 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_292_MA;
1863 } else if (bootstrapCurrent_mA <= 366.0f) {
1864 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_341_MA;
1865 } else {
1866 bootstrapCurrent = tmc9660::tmcl::BootstrapCurrentLimit::CUR_391_MA;
1867 }
1868
1869 ok &= configureBootstrapCurrentLimit(bootstrapCurrent);
1870
1871 // Step 1.6: Configure undervoltage protection (supply, VDRV, and bootstrap)
1872 // Supply level: Configured from profile (0=disabled, 1-16 map to HW levels 0-15)
1873 // VDRV protection: Enabled by default for safety
1874 // Bootstrap UVP: Enabled by default for safety (prevents gate drive failure from insufficient
1875 // bootstrap voltage)
1876 if (cfgY2) {
1877 ok &= configureUndervoltageProtection(
1878 profile.supplyLevel, // Supply level from profile
1879 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED, // VDRV protection (keep enabled)
1880 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED, // Bootstrap UVW (keep enabled for safety)
1881 tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED); // Bootstrap Y2 (keep enabled for safety)
1882 } else {
1883 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_LEVEL,
1884 static_cast<uint32_t>(profile.supplyLevel));
1885 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::VDRV_ENABLE,
1886 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED));
1887 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::BST_UVW_ENABLE,
1888 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::UndervoltageEnable::ENABLED));
1889 }
1890
1891 // ============================================================================
1892 // PART 2: PROTECTION PARAMETER CONFIGURATION
1893 // ============================================================================
1894
1895 if (profile.configure_gate_oc_vgs_protection) {
1896
1897 // Step 2.1: Estimate di/dt (current rise rate during switching)
1898 // di/dt ≈ V_bus / L_motor
1899 // Use worst-case low inductance for safety (higher di/dt → longer blanking needed)
1900 float di_dt_A_per_us;
1901 if (std::isnan(profile.motorInductance_uH) || profile.motorInductance_uH <= 0.0f) {
1902 // Conservative worst-case: assume low inductance (20 µH) for noisy motors
1903 // Note: Gear motors typically have higher inductance (50-100+ µH), but using
1904 // lower value ensures safer (longer) blanking time for worst-case scenarios
1905 constexpr float L_WORST_CASE_uH = 20.0f; // Fixed: was 50.0f, now matches comment
1906 di_dt_A_per_us = profile.busVoltage_V / L_WORST_CASE_uH;
1907 } else {
1908 di_dt_A_per_us = profile.busVoltage_V / profile.motorInductance_uH;
1909 }
1910
1911 // Step 2.2: Select overcurrent blanking time based on di/dt
1912 // Higher di/dt → longer blanking needed to ignore switching spikes
1913 // Apply blankingMargin safety factor to the base time
1914 float baseBlankingTime_us;
1915 if (di_dt_A_per_us < 5.0f) {
1916 baseBlankingTime_us = 0.25f;
1917 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 15.0f) {
1918 baseBlankingTime_us = 0.5f;
1919 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 30.0f) {
1920 baseBlankingTime_us = 1.0f;
1921 } else if (di_dt_A_per_us < 60.0f) {
1922 baseBlankingTime_us = 2.0f;
1923 } else {
1924 // Very high di/dt - use longer blanking, but cap at PWM period limit
1925 float pwmPeriod_us = 1000000.0f / profile.pwmFrequency_Hz;
1926 // Cap blanking at 15% of PWM period for normal frequencies
1927 // For very high frequencies (>100kHz), use more conservative 10% cap
1928 float maxBlankingRatio = (profile.pwmFrequency_Hz > 100000.0f) ? 0.10f : 0.15f;
1929 baseBlankingTime_us = pwmPeriod_us * maxBlankingRatio;
1930 // Ensure minimum blanking time scales with PWM period but has absolute floor
1931 // At very high frequencies, use 5% of period or 0.25µs minimum (whichever is larger)
1932 float minBlanking_us = std::max(0.25f, pwmPeriod_us * 0.05f);
1933 if (baseBlankingTime_us < minBlanking_us) {
1934 baseBlankingTime_us = minBlanking_us;
1935 }
1936 }
1937
1938 // Apply safety margin
1939 float targetBlankingTime_us = baseBlankingTime_us * profile.blankingMargin;
1940
1941 // Map to discrete register values (select next higher value for safety)
1942 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming ocBlanking;
1943 if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 0.25f) {
1944 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
1945 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 0.5f) {
1946 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
1947 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 1.0f) {
1948 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_1_MICROSEC;
1949 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 2.0f) {
1950 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_2_MICROSEC;
1951 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 4.0f) {
1952 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_4_MICROSEC;
1953 } else if (targetBlankingTime_us <= 6.0f) {
1954 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_6_MICROSEC;
1955 } else {
1956 ocBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_8_MICROSEC;
1957 }
1958
1959 // Step 2.3: Select deglitch time based on gate charge (Qg)
1960 // Low Qg = fast switching = more noise = longer deglitch needed
1961 // High Qg = slow switching = less noise = shorter deglitch OK
1962 // Apply blankingMargin safety factor
1963 float baseDeglitchTime_us;
1964 if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 15.0f) {
1965 // Fast FETs (GaN, low Qg) - need longer deglitch for noise filtering
1966 baseDeglitchTime_us = 2.0f;
1967 } else if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 40.0f) {
1968 // Normal FETs - moderate deglitch
1969 baseDeglitchTime_us = 1.0f;
1970 } else {
1971 // Slow FETs (high Qg) - shorter deglitch sufficient
1972 baseDeglitchTime_us = 0.5f;
1973 }
1974
1975 // Apply safety margin
1976 float targetDeglitchTime_us = baseDeglitchTime_us * profile.blankingMargin;
1977
1978 // Map to discrete register values (select next higher value for safety)
1979 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming ocDeglitch;
1980 if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 0.25f) {
1981 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
1982 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 0.5f) {
1983 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
1984 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 1.0f) {
1985 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_1_MICROSEC;
1986 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 2.0f) {
1987 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_2_MICROSEC;
1988 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 4.0f) {
1989 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_4_MICROSEC;
1990 } else if (targetDeglitchTime_us <= 6.0f) {
1991 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_6_MICROSEC;
1992 } else {
1993 ocDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentTiming::T_8_MICROSEC;
1994 }
1995
1996 // Step 2.4: Select VGS short protection blanking/deglitch based on gate charge
1997 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime vgsBlanking;
1998 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime vgsDeglitch;
1999 if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 15.0f) {
2000 // Fast FETs - longer blanking/deglitch
2001 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2002 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_2_MICROSEC;
2003 } else if (profile.mosfet_gateCharge_nC < 40.0f) {
2004 // Normal FETs
2005 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2006 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_1_MICROSEC;
2007 } else {
2008 // Slow FETs - shorter times
2009 vgsBlanking = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsBlankingTime::T_0_25_MICROSEC;
2010 vgsDeglitch = tmc9660::tmcl::VgsDeglitchTime::T_0_5_MICROSEC;
2011 }
2012
2013 // Step 2.5: Calculate overcurrent thresholds
2014 // TMC9660 uses dual sensing: RSHUNT for low-side (primary), VDS for high-side (always)
2015 // Low-side can optionally use VDS if Rds_on is low enough
2016 // Calculate separate thresholds for each sensing method
2017
2018 // RSHUNT threshold (for low-side when VDS disabled)
2019 // Threshold voltage = I_peak * margin * R_shunt
2020 float rshuntThreshold_mV =
2021 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A * profile.overcurrentMargin * profile.shuntResistance_mOhm;
2022
2023 // VDS threshold (for high-side always, and low-side if VDS enabled)
2024 // Threshold voltage = I_peak * margin * Rds_on
2025 float vdsThreshold_mV =
2026 profile.expectedPeakCurrent_A * profile.overcurrentMargin * profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm;
2027
2028 // Helper function to select threshold register value
2029 auto selectThreshold = [](float voltage_mV, bool isVds) -> tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold {
2030 // For VDS: use VDS values (lower); For RSHUNT: use RSHUNT values (higher)
2031 // Select smallest threshold >= calculated value for safety
2032 if (isVds) {
2033 // VDS threshold values
2034 if (voltage_mV <= 63.0f) {
2035 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_80_OR_63_MILLIVOLT; // 63mV VDS
2036 } else if (voltage_mV <= 125.0f) {
2037 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_165_OR_125_MILLIVOLT; // 125mV VDS
2038 } else if (voltage_mV <= 187.0f) {
2039 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_187_MILLIVOLT; // 187mV VDS
2040 } else if (voltage_mV <= 248.0f) {
2041 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_330_OR_248_MILLIVOLT; // 248mV VDS
2042 } else if (voltage_mV <= 312.0f) {
2043 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_415_OR_312_MILLIVOLT; // 312mV VDS
2044 } else if (voltage_mV <= 374.0f) {
2045 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_374_MILLIVOLT; // 374mV VDS
2046 } else if (voltage_mV <= 434.0f) {
2047 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_582_OR_434_MILLIVOLT; // 434mV VDS
2048 } else if (voltage_mV <= 504.0f) {
2049 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_660_OR_504_MILLIVOLT; // 504mV VDS
2050 } else if (voltage_mV <= 705.0f) {
2051 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_125_OR_705_MILLIVOLT; // 705mV VDS
2052 } else if (voltage_mV <= 940.0f) {
2053 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_940_MILLIVOLT; // 940mV VDS
2054 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1180.0f) {
2055 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_375_OR_1180_MILLIVOLT; // 1180mV VDS
2056 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1410.0f) {
2057 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_1410_MILLIVOLT; // 1410mV VDS
2058 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1650.0f) {
2059 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_625_OR_1650_MILLIVOLT; // 1650mV VDS
2060 } else if (voltage_mV <= 1880.0f) {
2061 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_750_OR_1880_MILLIVOLT; // 1880mV VDS
2062 } else if (voltage_mV <= 2110.0f) {
2063 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_875_OR_2110_MILLIVOLT; // 2110mV VDS
2064 } else {
2065 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_1000_OR_2350_MILLIVOLT; // 2350mV VDS (max)
2066 }
2067 } else {
2068 // RSHUNT threshold values (higher than VDS for same current)
2069 // Hardware automatically selects RSHUNT value when VDS is disabled for low-side
2070 if (voltage_mV <= 80.0f) {
2071 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_80_OR_63_MILLIVOLT; // 80mV RSHUNT
2072 } else if (voltage_mV <= 125.0f) {
2073 // Special case: V_125_OR_705 provides 125mV RSHUNT (maps to 705mV VDS for high-side)
2074 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_125_OR_705_MILLIVOLT;
2075 } else if (voltage_mV <= 165.0f) {
2076 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_165_OR_125_MILLIVOLT; // 165mV RSHUNT
2077 } else if (voltage_mV <= 250.0f) {
2078 // V_250_OR_187 provides 250mV RSHUNT (normal case)
2079 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_250_OR_187_MILLIVOLT;
2080 } else if (voltage_mV <= 330.0f) {
2081 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_330_OR_248_MILLIVOLT; // 330mV RSHUNT
2082 } else if (voltage_mV <= 375.0f) {
2083 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_375_OR_1180_MILLIVOLT; // 375mV RSHUNT
2084 } else if (voltage_mV <= 415.0f) {
2085 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_415_OR_312_MILLIVOLT; // 415mV RSHUNT
2086 } else if (voltage_mV <= 500.0f) {
2087 // V_500_OR_374 provides 500mV RSHUNT (normal case)
2088 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_500_OR_374_MILLIVOLT;
2089 } else if (voltage_mV <= 582.0f) {
2090 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_582_OR_434_MILLIVOLT; // 582mV RSHUNT
2091 } else if (voltage_mV <= 625.0f) {
2092 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_625_OR_1650_MILLIVOLT; // 625mV RSHUNT
2093 } else if (voltage_mV <= 660.0f) {
2094 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_660_OR_504_MILLIVOLT; // 660mV RSHUNT
2095 } else if (voltage_mV <= 750.0f) {
2096 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_750_OR_1880_MILLIVOLT; // 750mV RSHUNT
2097 } else if (voltage_mV <= 875.0f) {
2098 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_875_OR_2110_MILLIVOLT; // 875mV RSHUNT
2099 } else {
2100 return tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold::V_1000_OR_2350_MILLIVOLT; // 1000mV RSHUNT (max)
2101 }
2102 }
2103 };
2104
2105 // Step 2.6: Determine if VDS should be used for low-side
2106 // VDS sensing is reliable when Rds_on is very low (< 10 mΩ) and for low bus voltages
2107 // For high-performance drives, RSHUNT is typically preferred for low-side
2108 bool useVdsLowSide = (profile.mosfet_RdsOn_mOhm < 10.0f);
2109
2110 // Select appropriate thresholds
2111 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold ocThresholdLowSide =
2112 useVdsLowSide ? selectThreshold(vdsThreshold_mV, true) // Use VDS threshold
2113 : selectThreshold(rshuntThreshold_mV, false); // Use RSHUNT threshold
2114 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentThreshold ocThresholdHighSide =
2115 selectThreshold(vdsThreshold_mV, true); // Always VDS
2116
2117 // Step 2.7: Configure all protection parameters
2118 // 2.7.1: Enable overcurrent protection
2119 if (cfgY2) {
2120 ok &= enableOvercurrentProtection(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // UVW low side
2121 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // UVW high side
2122 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED, // Y2 low side
2123 tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED); // Y2 high side
2124 } else {
2125 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE,
2126 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED));
2127 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE,
2128 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED));
2129 }
2130
2131 // 2.7.2: Set overcurrent thresholds (separate for low-side and high-side)
2132 if (cfgY2) {
2133 ok &= setOvercurrentThresholds(
2134 ocThresholdLowSide, // UVW low side (RSHUNT or VDS based on useVdsLowSide)
2135 ocThresholdHighSide, // UVW high side (always VDS)
2136 ocThresholdLowSide, // Y2 low side (RSHUNT or VDS based on useVdsLowSide)
2137 ocThresholdHighSide); // Y2 high side (always VDS)
2138 } else {
2139 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_THRESHOLD,
2140 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocThresholdLowSide));
2141 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_THRESHOLD,
2142 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocThresholdHighSide));
2143 }
2144
2145 // 2.7.3: Set overcurrent blanking times
2146 if (cfgY2) {
2147 ok &= setOvercurrentBlanking(ocBlanking, // UVW low side
2148 ocBlanking, // UVW high side
2149 ocBlanking, // Y2 low side
2150 ocBlanking); // Y2 high side
2151 } else {
2152 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_BLANKING,
2153 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocBlanking));
2154 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_BLANKING,
2155 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocBlanking));
2156 }
2157
2158 // 2.7.4: Set overcurrent deglitch times
2159 if (cfgY2) {
2160 ok &= setOvercurrentDeglitch(ocDeglitch, // UVW low side
2161 ocDeglitch, // UVW high side
2162 ocDeglitch, // Y2 low side
2163 ocDeglitch); // Y2 high side
2164 } else {
2165 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_DEGLITCH,
2166 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocDeglitch));
2167 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_DEGLITCH,
2168 static_cast<uint32_t>(ocDeglitch));
2169 }
2170
2171 // 2.7.5: Enable/disable VDS monitoring for low-side
2172 if (cfgY2) {
2173 ok &= enableVdsMonitoringLow(
2174 useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED, // UVW
2175 useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED); // Y2
2176 } else {
2177 ok &= driver.writeParameter(
2178 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_USE_VDS,
2179 static_cast<uint32_t>(useVdsLowSide ? tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::ENABLED
2180 : tmc9660::tmcl::VdsUsage::DISABLED));
2181 }
2182
2183 // 2.7.6: Enable VGS short protection (all transitions)
2184 ok &= configureVgsShortProtectionUVW(tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side ON
2185 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side OFF
2186 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // High side ON
2187 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED); // High side OFF
2188
2189 if (cfgY2) {
2190 ok &= configureVgsShortProtectionY2(tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side ON
2191 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // Low side OFF
2192 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED, // High side ON
2193 tmc9660::tmcl::VgsShortEnable::ENABLED); // High side OFF
2194 }
2195
2196 // 2.7.7: Set VGS short blanking and deglitch times
2197 if (cfgY2) {
2198 ok &= setVgsShortBlankingTime(vgsBlanking, vgsBlanking); // UVW, Y2
2199 ok &= setVgsShortDeglitchTime(vgsDeglitch, vgsDeglitch); // UVW, Y2
2200 } else {
2201 ok &= driver.writeParameter( tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_BLANKING,
2202 static_cast<uint32_t>(vgsBlanking));
2203 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::UVW_DEGLITCH,
2204 static_cast<uint32_t>(vgsDeglitch));
2205 }
2206
2207 // ============================================================================
2208 // PART 3: FAULT HANDLING CONFIGURATION
2209 // ============================================================================
2210
2211 // Step 3.1: Configure retry behavior after gate driver fault
2212 ok &= setRetryBehavior(profile.retryBehaviour);
2213
2214 // Step 3.2: Configure drive fault behavior after all retries fail
2215 ok &= setDriveFaultBehavior(profile.faultBehaviour);
2216
2217 // Step 3.3: Set maximum number of fault handler retries
2218 ok &= setFaultHandlerRetries(profile.faultHandlerRetries);
2219
2220 } // configure_gate_oc_vgs_protection
2221
2222 return ok;
2223}

2298template <typename CommType>
2299int16_t TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::degreesToHallOffset(float degrees) noexcept {
2300 // Convert degrees to 16-bit signed integer representation
2301 // Formula: value = (degrees * 65536) / 360
2302 // This maps 360° to the full 16-bit range (-32768 to 32767)
2303 constexpr float DEGREES_TO_UNITS = 65536.0f / 360.0f;
2304 float value = degrees * DEGREES_TO_UNITS;
2305
2306 // Round to nearest integer
2307 int32_t intValue = static_cast<int32_t>(value + (value >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f));
2308
2309 // Wrap around to stay within 16-bit signed integer range [-32768, 32767]
2310 // This handles angles > 360° or < -360° by normalizing using modulo arithmetic
2311 constexpr int32_t RANGE = 65536;
2312 intValue %= RANGE;
2313 // Normalize negative modulo results to positive range [0, 65535]
2314 if (intValue < 0) {
2315 intValue += RANGE;
2316 }
2317 // Convert values in [32768, 65535] to negative range [-32768, -1]
2318 if (intValue > 32767) {
2319 intValue -= RANGE;
2320 }
2321
2322 return static_cast<int16_t>(intValue);
2323}
2324
2325template <typename CommType>
2326int16_t TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::radiansToHallOffset(float radians) noexcept {
2327 // Convert radians to 16-bit signed integer representation
2328 // Formula: value = (radians * 65536) / (2 * π)
2329 // This maps 2π radians to the full 16-bit range (-32768 to 32767)
2330 constexpr float RADIANS_TO_UNITS = 65536.0f / (2.0f * 3.14159265358979323846f);
2331 float value = radians * RADIANS_TO_UNITS;
2332
2333 // Round to nearest integer
2334 int32_t intValue = static_cast<int32_t>(value + (value >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f));
2335
2336 // Wrap around to stay within 16-bit signed integer range [-32768, 32767]
2337 // This handles angles > 2π or < -2π by normalizing using modulo arithmetic
2338 constexpr int32_t RANGE = 65536;
2339 intValue %= RANGE;
2340 // Normalize negative modulo results to positive range [0, 65535]
2341 if (intValue < 0) {
2342 intValue += RANGE;
2343 }
2344 // Convert values in [32768, 65535] to negative range [-32768, -1]
2345 if (intValue > 32767) {
2346 intValue -= RANGE;
2347 }
2348
2349 return static_cast<int16_t>(intValue);
2350}

2501bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureSPIEncoderDataFormat(
2502 uint32_t positionMask, uint8_t positionShift,
2503 tmc9660::tmcl::Direction invertDirection) noexcept {
2504 bool ok = true;
2505 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_POSITION_COUNTER_MASK,
2506 positionMask);
2507 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_POSITION_COUNTER_SHIFT,
2508 positionShift);

2514template <typename CommType>
2515bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::setSPIEncoderRequestData(const uint8_t* requestData,
2516 uint8_t size) noexcept {
2517 if (size == 0 || size > 16)
2518 return false;
2519 uint32_t w0 = 0, w1 = 0, w2 = 0, w3 = 0;
2520 for (uint8_t i = 0; i < size && i < 16; ++i) {
2521 uint32_t val = static_cast<uint32_t>(requestData[i]) & 0xFFu;
2522 if (i < 4)
2523 w0 |= val << (8 * i);
2524 else if (i < 8)
2525 w1 |= val << (8 * (i - 4));
2526 else if (i < 12)
2527 w2 |= val << (8 * (i - 8));
2528 else
2529 w3 |= val << (8 * (i - 12));
2530 }
2531 bool ok = true;
2532 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_3_0, w0);
2533 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_7_4, w1);
2534 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_11_8, w2);
2535 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER_DATA_15_12, w3);
2536 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_MAIN_TRANSFER_CMD_SIZE, size);
2537 return ok;
2538}

2687
2688template <typename CommType>
2689bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const HallConfig& config) noexcept {
2690 bool ok = true;
2691
2692 // Step 1: Configure basic Hall sensor settings
2693 ok &= configureHall(config.sectorOffset, config.direction, config.extrapolation,
2694 config.filterLength);
2695
2696 // Step 2: Set position offsets if provided
2697 if (config.offset0Deg.has_value() || config.offset60Deg.has_value() ||
2698 config.offset120Deg.has_value() || config.offset180Deg.has_value() ||
2699 config.offset240Deg.has_value() || config.offset300Deg.has_value() ||
2700 config.globalOffsetDeg.has_value()) {
2701 // Use provided values or defaults
2702 float offset0 = config.offset0Deg.value_or(0.0f);
2703 float offset60 = config.offset60Deg.value_or(60.0f);
2704 float offset120 = config.offset120Deg.value_or(120.0f);
2705 float offset180 = config.offset180Deg.value_or(180.0f);
2706 float offset240 = config.offset240Deg.value_or(240.0f);
2707 float offset300 = config.offset300Deg.value_or(300.0f);
2708 float globalOffset = config.globalOffsetDeg.value_or(0.0f);
2709
2710 ok &= setHallPositionOffsetsDegrees(offset0, offset60, offset120, offset180, offset240,
2711 offset300, globalOffset);
2712 }
2713
2714 return ok;
2715}
2716
2717template <typename CommType>
2718bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const AbnConfig& config) noexcept {
2719 bool ok = true;
2720
2721 // Step 1: Configure ABN encoder basic settings
2722 ok &= configureABNEncoder(config.countsPerRev, config.direction, config.nChannelInverted);
2723
2724 // Step 2: Configure ABN initialization method
2725 ok &= configureABNInitialization(config.initMethod, config.initDelay, config.initVelocity,
2726 config.nChannelOffset);
2727
2728 // Step 3: Configure N-channel filtering
2729 ok &= configureABNNChannel(config.nChannelFiltering, config.clearOnNextNull);
2730
2731 // Step 4: For FORCED_PHI_E_* init methods, optionally set OPENLOOP_CURRENT
2732 // (param 46, mA). The datasheet (param-mode line 2411-2422) specifies that
2733 // this current — not OPENLOOP_VOLTAGE — is what physically drives the rotor
2734 // to a known electrical angle during alignment. We only write it when the
2735 // caller explicitly opts in (initOpenloopCurrent_mA != 0) so that callers
2736 // using USE_HALL / USE_N_CHANNEL_OFFSET / USE_OFFSET (no alignment current
2737 // needed) and callers who already set OPENLOOP_CURRENT elsewhere are
2738 // unaffected.
2739 const bool needsAlignmentCurrent =
2740 (config.initMethod == tmc9660::tmcl::AbnInitMethod::FORCED_PHI_E_ZERO_WITH_ACTIVE_SWING) ||
2741 (config.initMethod == tmc9660::tmcl::AbnInitMethod::FORCED_PHI_E_90_ZERO);
2742 if (needsAlignmentCurrent && config.initOpenloopCurrent_mA != 0) {
2743 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::OPENLOOP_CURRENT,
2744 static_cast<uint32_t>(config.initOpenloopCurrent_mA));
2745 }
2746
2747 return ok;
2748}
2749
2750template <typename CommType>
2751bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const Abn2Config& config) noexcept {
2752 bool ok = true;
2753
2754 // Configure secondary ABN encoder
2755 ok &= configureSecondaryABNEncoder(config.countsPerRev, config.direction, config.gearRatio);
2756
2757 // Enable or disable the encoder
2758 ok &= setSecondaryABNEncoderEnabled(config.enable);
2759
2760 return ok;
2761}
2762
2763template <typename CommType>
2764bool TMC9660<CommType>::FeedbackSense::configureAuto(const SpiEncoderConfig& config) noexcept {
2765 // Capability gate: SPI encoder must be enabled in the bootloader (so the chip muxes the
2766 // CS / SCK / MISO pins to the SPI-encoder block). When disabled, every SPI-encoder NR
2767 // (181..201) returns REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE — surface that as a single clear host-side
2768 // ERROR before issuing 5+ doomed SAPs.
2769 if (!driver.capabilities().spiEncoder) {
2770 driver.comm().logDebug(
2771 0, "TMC9660",
2772 "FeedbackSense::configureAuto(SpiEncoder): subsystem disabled — set "
2773 "BootloaderConfig.spiEnc.enable=true (and re-run bootloader) to use SPI encoder.");
2774 return false;
2775 }
2776
2777 bool ok = true;
2778
2779 // Step 1: Configure SPI encoder timing and frame size
2780 ok &= configureSPIEncoder(config.cmdSize, config.csSettleTimeNs, config.csIdleTimeUs);
2781
2782 // Step 2: Configure SPI encoder data format
2783 ok &= configureSPIEncoderDataFormat(config.positionMask, config.positionShift, config.direction);
2784
2785 // Step 3: Set request data for continuous transfer mode if provided
2786 if (config.requestData.has_value()) {
2787 ok &= setSPIEncoderRequestData(config.requestData->data(), config.cmdSize);
2788
2789 // Enable continuous transfer mode
2790 ok &= driver.writeParameter(
2791 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SPI_ENCODER_TRANSFER,
2792 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::SpiEncoderTransfer::CONTINUOUS_POSITION_COUNTER_READ));
2793 }
2794
2795 // Step 4: Configure SPI encoder initialization
2796 ok &= configureSPIEncoderInitialization(config.initMethod, config.offset);
2797
2798 // Step 5: Configure LUT correction if enabled
2799 if (config.lutCorrection == tmc9660::tmcl::EnableDisable::ENABLED) {
2800 ok &= setSPIEncoderLUTCorrection(config.lutCorrection, config.lutShiftFactor);
2801 }
2802
2803 return ok;
2804}
