2947//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
2948// Auto-Configuration
2949//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
2950
2951template <typename CommType>
2952bool TMC9660<CommType>::TorqueFluxControl::configureAuto(const TorqueFluxConfig& config) noexcept {
2953 bool ok = true;
2954
2955 // Step 1: Calculate or use provided PI gains
2956 uint16_t torqueP, torqueI;
2957 uint16_t fluxP, fluxI;
2958
2959 if (config.torqueP.has_value() && config.torqueI.has_value()) {
2960 // User provided direct PI gains - use them
2961 torqueP = config.torqueP.value();
2962 torqueI = config.torqueI.value();
2963 } else {
2964 // No direct gains provided - use defaults
2965 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 50;
2966 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 100;
2967 torqueP = DEFAULT_P;
2968 torqueI = DEFAULT_I;
2969 }
2970
2971 // Flux gains: use provided values, or default to torque gains
2972 if (config.separateTorqueFluxLoops) {
2973 if (config.fluxP.has_value() && config.fluxI.has_value()) {
2974 fluxP = config.fluxP.value();
2975 fluxI = config.fluxI.value();
2976 } else {
2977 // Default flux gains to torque gains
2978 fluxP = torqueP;
2979 fluxI = torqueI;
2980 }
2981 } else {
2982 // Not used when loops are combined, but initialize anyway
2983 fluxP = torqueP;
2984 fluxI = torqueI;
2985 }
2986
2987 // Step 2: Configure torque/flux loop separation and PI gains
2988 if (config.separateTorqueFluxLoops) {
2989 ok &=
2990 setTorqueFluxPiSeparation(tmc9660::tmcl::TorqueFluxPiSeparation::TORQUE_FLUX_PI_SEPARATED);
2991 ok &= setCurrentLoopGains(torqueP, torqueI, true, fluxP, fluxI);
2992 } else {
2993 ok &= setTorqueFluxPiSeparation(tmc9660::tmcl::TorqueFluxPiSeparation::TORQUE_FLUX_PI_COMBINED);
2994 ok &= setCurrentLoopGains(torqueP, torqueI, false);
2995 }
2996
2997 // Step 3: Configure normalization (use provided values or defaults)
2998 // Default: SHIFT_8_BIT for P (good balance), SHIFT_16_BIT for I (better precision)
2999 // These defaults match the datasheet defaults and work well for most motors.
3000 tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization pNorm =
3001 config.pNormalization.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization::SHIFT_8_BIT);
3002 tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization iNorm =
3003 config.iNormalization.value_or(tmc9660::tmcl::CurrentPiNormalization::SHIFT_16_BIT);
3004 ok &= setCurrentNormalization(pNorm, iNorm);
3005
3006 // Step 4: Configure offsets
3007 ok &= setTorqueOffset(config.torqueOffset_mA);
3008 ok &= setFluxOffset(config.fluxOffset_mA);
3009
3010 // Step 5: Configure field weakening if enabled
3011 if (config.enableFieldWeakening) {
3012 ok &= setFieldWeakeningI(config.fieldWeakeningI);
3013
3014 // Convert percentage threshold to register value
3015 // Read current OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT to calculate threshold
3016 uint16_t outputVoltageLimit;
3017 if (driver.motorConfig.getOutputVoltageLimit(outputVoltageLimit)) {
3018 // Calculate threshold as percentage of OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT
3019 float thresholdValue =
3020 static_cast<float>(outputVoltageLimit) * config.fieldWeakeningVoltageThresholdPercent;
3021 uint16_t thresholdRegister = static_cast<uint16_t>(thresholdValue + 0.5f);
3022
3023 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
3024 if (thresholdRegister > 32767)
3025 thresholdRegister = 32767;
3026
3027 ok &= setFieldWeakeningVoltageThreshold(thresholdRegister);
3028 } else {
3029 // Fallback: use percentage of default OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT (8000)
3030 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT = 8000;
3031 float thresholdValue = static_cast<float>(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT) *
3032 config.fieldWeakeningVoltageThresholdPercent;
3033 uint16_t thresholdRegister = static_cast<uint16_t>(thresholdValue + 0.5f);
3034 ok &= setFieldWeakeningVoltageThreshold(thresholdRegister);
3035 }
3036 }
3037
3038 // Step 6: Configure torque biquad filter if enabled
3039 if (config.enableTorqueBiquadFilter) {
3040 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterEnable(true);
3041
3042 // Configure biquad filter coefficients if provided
3043 // Note: Coefficients are in Q4.20 format (24-bit, 4 integer + 20 fractional bits)
3044 // Default values if not provided: BCOEFF_0 = 1048576 (1.0), others = 0
3045 if (config.biquadACoeff1.has_value()) {
3046 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterACoeff1(config.biquadACoeff1.value());
3047 }
3048 if (config.biquadACoeff2.has_value()) {
3049 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterACoeff2(config.biquadACoeff2.value());
3050 }
3051 if (config.biquadBCoeff0.has_value()) {
3052 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff0(config.biquadBCoeff0.value());
3053 }
3054 if (config.biquadBCoeff1.has_value()) {
3055 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff1(config.biquadBCoeff1.value());
3056 }
3057 if (config.biquadBCoeff2.has_value()) {
3058 ok &= setTargetTorqueBiquadFilterBCoeff2(config.biquadBCoeff2.value());
3059 }
3060 // If coefficients are not provided, filter uses hardware defaults:
3061 // BCOEFF_0 = 1048576 (1.0 in Q4.20), all others = 0 (pass-through)
3062 }
3063
3064 return ok;
3065}

3284//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3285// Auto-Configuration
3286//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3287
3288template <typename CommType>
3289bool TMC9660<CommType>::VelocityControl::configureAuto(const VelocityConfig& config) noexcept {
3290 bool ok = true;
3291
3292 // Step 1: Configure velocity sensor selection
3293 ok &= setVelocitySensor(config.sensorSelection);
3294
3295 // Step 2: Configure PI gains (use provided values or defaults)
3296 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 800; // Default P gain (typical for velocity control)
3297 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 1; // Default I gain (typical for velocity control)
3298
3299 uint16_t velocityP = config.velocityP.value_or(DEFAULT_P);
3300 uint16_t velocityI = config.velocityI.value_or(DEFAULT_I);
3301
3302 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
3303 if (velocityP > 32767)
3304 velocityP = 32767;
3305 if (velocityI > 32767)
3306 velocityI = 32767;
3307 if (velocityI < 1)
3308 velocityI = 1; // Minimum I gain
3309
3310 ok &= setVelocityLoopGains(velocityP, velocityI);
3311
3312 // Step 3: Configure normalization
3313 ok &= setVelocityNormalization(config.pNormalization, config.iNormalization);
3314
3315 // Step 4: Configure velocity scaling factor
3316 // Formula from datasheet: k_RPM = (CPR × 2^24) / (40MHz × 60)
3317 // Note: It's recommended to leave scaling at 1 and handle conversion externally
3318 uint16_t velocityScalingFactor = 1; // Default: no internal scaling
3319 uint32_t cpr = 0; // Counts per mechanical revolution (used later for meter threshold)
3320
3321 // Always calculate CPR (needed for meter threshold calculation even if scaling is provided)
3322 uint8_t pole_pairs = 1;
3323 if (config.motor_polePairs.has_value()) {
3324 pole_pairs = config.motor_polePairs.value();
3325 } else {
3326 // Read from MotorConfig
3327 uint32_t motorTypeVal, polePairsVal;
3328 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_TYPE, motorTypeVal) &&
3329 driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS, polePairsVal)) {
3330 pole_pairs = static_cast<uint8_t>(polePairsVal);
3331 }
3332 }
3333
3334 // Calculate CPR based on sensor type
3335 switch (config.sensorSelection) {
3336 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SAME_AS_COMMUTATION:
3337 // CPR = 2^16 × motorPolePairs
3338 cpr = static_cast<uint32_t>(65536UL * pole_pairs);
3339 break;
3340 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::DIGITAL_HALL:
3341 // CPR = 6 × motorPolePairs
3342 cpr = static_cast<uint32_t>(6 * pole_pairs);
3343 break;
3344 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN1_ENCODER:
3345 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN2_ENCODER:
3346 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SPI_ENCODER:
3347 // CPR = encoderCountsPerRev (from encoder datasheet)
3348 if (config.encoderCountsPerRev.has_value()) {
3349 cpr = config.encoderCountsPerRev.value();
3350 }
3351 // If not provided, cpr remains 0
3352 break;
3353 }
3354
3355 // Calculate or use provided scaling factor
3356 if (config.velocityScalingFactor.has_value()) {
3357 // User provided explicit scaling factor
3358 velocityScalingFactor = config.velocityScalingFactor.value();
3359 } else if (cpr > 0) {
3360 // Auto-calculate scaling factor from CPR
3361 // Formula: k_RPM = (CPR × 2^24) / (40MHz × 60)
3362 constexpr float CONST_40MHZ_60 = 2400000000.0f; // 40MHz × 60
3363 constexpr float CONST_2_24 = 16777216.0f; // 2^24
3364
3365 float k_rpm = (static_cast<float>(cpr) * CONST_2_24) / CONST_40MHZ_60;
3366 velocityScalingFactor = static_cast<uint16_t>(k_rpm + 0.5f);
3367
3368 // Clamp to valid range [1-2047]
3369 if (velocityScalingFactor < 1)
3370 velocityScalingFactor = 1;
3371 if (velocityScalingFactor > 2047)
3372 velocityScalingFactor = 2047;
3373 }
3374 // If cpr == 0 and no explicit scaling, use default scaling factor of 1
3375
3376 ok &= setVelocityScalingFactor(velocityScalingFactor);
3377
3378 // Step 5: Configure velocity loop downsampling
3379 ok &= setVelocityLoopDownsampling(config.loopDownsampling);
3380
3381 // Step 6: Configure velocity reached threshold
3382 // Note: VELOCITY_REACHED_THRESHOLD is not a configurable parameter in TMC9660.
3383 // The VELOCITY_REACHED flag is set when both actual and target velocity are below
3384 // an internal threshold. The config.velocityReachedThreshold value is ignored.
3385 // (Parameter 134 is STOP_ON_VELOCITY_DEVIATION, not VELOCITY_REACHED_THRESHOLD)
3386
3387 // Step 7: Configure stop on deviation if enabled
3388 if (config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.has_value()) {
3389 ok &= setStopOnVelocityDeviation(config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.value(),
3390 config.stopOnDeviationSoftStop);
3391 }
3392
3393 // Step 8: Configure velocity meter switch threshold
3394 // Auto-calculate optimal threshold if not provided
3395 uint32_t meterThreshold = 2000; // Default value
3396
3397 if (config.meterSwitchThreshold.has_value()) {
3398 meterThreshold = config.meterSwitchThreshold.value();
3399 } else if (cpr > 0) {
3400 // Auto-calculate optimal switchover point
3401 // Need: CPR (already calculated in Step 4), PWM frequency, loop downsampling, and velocity
3402 // scaling factor
3403
3404 // Get PWM frequency
3405 uint32_t pwmFreq = 25000; // Default 25kHz
3406 if (config.pwmFrequency_Hz.has_value()) {
3407 pwmFreq = config.pwmFrequency_Hz.value();
3408 } else {
3409 uint32_t pwmFreqVal;
3410 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_PWM_FREQUENCY, pwmFreqVal)) {
3411 pwmFreq = pwmFreqVal;
3412 }
3413 }
3414
3415 // Calculate velocity loop frequency
3416 // From datasheet: velocity loop frequency depends on PWM frequency and downsampling
3417 // f_Velo = f_PWM / (VELOCITY_LOOP_DOWNSAMPLING + 1)
3418 // Note: This is the actual execution frequency of the velocity control loop
3419 float f_velo = static_cast<float>(pwmFreq) / static_cast<float>(config.loopDownsampling + 1);
3420
3421 // Calculate optimal switchover threshold if we have CPR
3422 if (cpr > 0) {
3423 // Formula 1: v_PerLim_RPM = 0.9 × (40MHz) / (CPR × 60 × 53)
3424 constexpr float CONST_40MHZ = 40000000.0f;
3425 float v_per_lim_rpm = 0.9f * CONST_40MHZ / (static_cast<float>(cpr) * 60.0f * 53.0f);
3426
3427 // Formula 2: v_COP_RPM = 60 × (f_Velo + sqrt(f_Velo² + f_Velo × 40MHz × 8)) / (4 × CPR)
3428 float f_velo_sq = f_velo * f_velo;
3429 float sqrt_term = std::sqrt(f_velo_sq + f_velo * CONST_40MHZ * 8.0f);
3430 float v_cop_rpm = 60.0f * (f_velo + sqrt_term) / (4.0f * static_cast<float>(cpr));
3431
3432 // Choose the smaller value
3433 float v_thr_rpm = std::min(v_per_lim_rpm, v_cop_rpm);
3434
3435 // Convert to internal units: threshold = v_THR_RPM × k_RPM
3436 float threshold = v_thr_rpm * static_cast<float>(velocityScalingFactor);
3437 meterThreshold = static_cast<uint32_t>(threshold + 0.5f);
3438
3439 // Clamp to valid range [0-134217727]
3440 if (meterThreshold > 134217727U)
3441 meterThreshold = 134217727U;
3442 }
3443 // If cpr == 0, use default threshold of 2000
3444 }
3445
3446 ok &= setVelocityMeterSwitchThreshold(meterThreshold);
3447 ok &= setVelocityMeterSwitchHysteresis(config.meterHysteresis);
3448
3449 // Step 9: Configure velocity offset (raw internal units; this autoconfig
3450 // path bypasses the engineering-units API by design — the offset is set
3451 // alongside the velocity-scaling factor in raw form for consistency).
3452 ok &= setVelocityOffsetRaw(config.velocityOffset);
3453
3454 // Step 10: Configure velocity biquad filter
3455 // Note: Velocity biquad filter is enabled by default in hardware for noise reduction
3456 if (config.enableVelocityBiquadFilter.has_value()) {
3457 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterEnable(config.enableVelocityBiquadFilter.value());
3458 }
3459 // If not explicitly set, filter remains in its default state (enabled)
3460
3461 // Configure velocity biquad filter coefficients if provided
3462 // Note: Coefficients are in Q4.20 format (24-bit, 4 integer + 20 fractional bits)
3463 // Default values if not provided: Hardware-optimized defaults for velocity noise reduction
3464 if (config.velocityBiquadACoeff1.has_value()) {
3465 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterACoeff1(config.velocityBiquadACoeff1.value());
3466 }
3467 if (config.velocityBiquadACoeff2.has_value()) {
3468 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterACoeff2(config.velocityBiquadACoeff2.value());
3469 }
3470 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff0.has_value()) {
3471 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff0(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff0.value());
3472 }
3473 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff1.has_value()) {
3474 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff1(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff1.value());
3475 }
3476 if (config.velocityBiquadBCoeff2.has_value()) {
3477 ok &= setActualVelocityBiquadFilterBCoeff2(config.velocityBiquadBCoeff2.value());
3478 }
3479
3480 return ok;
3481}

3883//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3884// Auto-Configuration
3885//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
3886
3887template <typename CommType>
3888bool TMC9660<CommType>::PositionControl::configureAuto(const PositionConfig& config) noexcept {
3889 bool ok = true;
3890
3891 // Step 1: Configure position sensor selection
3892 ok &= setPositionSensor(config.sensorSelection);
3893
3894 // Step 2: Configure PI gains (use provided values or defaults)
3895 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_P = 2000; // Default P gain (typical for position control)
3896 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I = 100; // Default I gain (typical for position control)
3897
3898 uint16_t positionP = config.positionP.value_or(DEFAULT_P);
3899 uint16_t positionI = config.positionI.value_or(DEFAULT_I);
3900
3901 // Clamp to valid range [0-32767]
3902 if (positionP > 32767)
3903 positionP = 32767;
3904 if (positionI > 32767)
3905 positionI = 32767;
3906 if (positionI < 1)
3907 positionI = 1; // Minimum I gain
3908
3909 ok &= setPositionLoopGains(positionP, positionI);
3910
3911 // Step 3: Configure normalization
3912 ok &= setPositionNormalization(config.pNormalization, config.iNormalization);
3913
3914 // Step 4: Configure position scaling factor
3915 if (config.positionScalingFactor.has_value()) {
3916 ok &= setPositionScalingFactor(config.positionScalingFactor.value());
3917 } else if (config.encoderCountsPerRev.has_value()) {
3918 // Auto-calculate scaling factor from encoder CPR
3919 // Similar to velocity scaling, use simplified calculation
3920 uint32_t cpr = config.encoderCountsPerRev.value();
3921 if (cpr > 0) {
3922 // Simplified: assume 1:1 scaling for now (user should provide explicit scaling if needed)
3923 ok &= setPositionScalingFactor(1);
3924 }
3925 }
3926
3927 // Step 5: Configure position loop downsampling
3928 ok &= setPositionLoopDownsampling(config.loopDownsampling);
3929
3930 // Step 6: Configure position limits if provided
3931 if (config.positionLimitLow.has_value()) {
3932 ok &= setPositionLimitLow(config.positionLimitLow.value());
3933 }
3934 if (config.positionLimitHigh.has_value()) {
3935 ok &= setPositionLimitHigh(config.positionLimitHigh.value());
3936 }
3937
3938 // Step 7: Configure position reached threshold
3939 ok &= setPositionReachedThreshold(config.positionReachedThreshold);
3940
3941 // Step 8: Configure stop on deviation if enabled
3942 if (config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.has_value()) {
3943 ok &= setStopOnPositionDeviation(config.stopOnDeviationMaxError.value(),
3944 config.stopOnDeviationSoftStop);
3945 }
3946
3947 return ok;
3948}

4344//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4345// Auto-Configuration
4346//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4347
4348template <typename CommType>
4349bool TMC9660<CommType>::Ramp::configureAuto(const RampConfig& config) noexcept {
4350 bool ok = true;
4351
4352 // Step 1: Configure acceleration segments
4353 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_AMAX = 1000;
4354 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_A1 = 8000;
4355 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_A2 = 4000;
4356
4357 uint32_t aMax = config.maxAcceleration.value_or(DEFAULT_AMAX);
4358 uint32_t a1 = config.acceleration1.value_or(DEFAULT_A1);
4359 uint32_t a2 = config.acceleration2.value_or(DEFAULT_A2);
4360
4361 ok &= setAcceleration(a1, a2, aMax);
4362
4363 // Step 2: Configure deceleration segments
4364 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_DMAX = 1000;
4365 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_D1 = 8000;
4366 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_D2 = 8000;
4367
4368 uint32_t dMax = config.maxDeceleration.value_or(DEFAULT_DMAX);
4369 uint32_t d1 = config.deceleration1.value_or(DEFAULT_D1);
4370 uint32_t d2 = config.deceleration2.value_or(DEFAULT_D2);
4371
4372 ok &= setDeceleration(d1, d2, dMax);
4373
4374 // Step 3: Configure velocity thresholds and limits
4375 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_V1 = 0;
4376 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_V2 = 0;
4377 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_VSTART = 0;
4378 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_VSTOP = 1;
4379
4380 uint32_t v1 = config.velocityThreshold1.value_or(DEFAULT_V1);
4381 uint32_t v2 = config.velocityThreshold2.value_or(DEFAULT_V2);
4382 uint32_t vStart = config.startVelocity.value_or(DEFAULT_VSTART);
4383 uint32_t vStop = config.stopVelocity.value_or(DEFAULT_VSTOP);
4384 uint32_t vMax = config.maxVelocity; // Required parameter, no default
4385
4386 ok &= setVelocities(vStart, vStop, v1, v2, vMax);
4387
4388 // Step 4: Configure timing constraints
4389 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_TVMAX = 0;
4390 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_TZEROWAIT = 0;
4391
4392 uint16_t tVmax = config.timeAtVmax.value_or(DEFAULT_TVMAX);
4393 uint16_t tZeroWait = config.timeZeroWait.value_or(DEFAULT_TZEROWAIT);
4394
4395 ok &= setTiming(tVmax, tZeroWait);
4396
4397 // Step 5: Configure feedforward
4398 constexpr bool DEFAULT_VEL_FF = false;
4399 constexpr bool DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF = false;
4400 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_GAIN = 8;
4401 constexpr tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_SHIFT =
4402 tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift::SHIFT_4_BIT;
4403
4404 bool enableVelFF = config.enableVelocityFeedForward.value_or(DEFAULT_VEL_FF);
4405 bool enableAccelFF = config.enableAccelerationFeedForward.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF);
4406 uint16_t accelFFGain = config.accelerationFeedForwardGain.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_GAIN);
4407 tmc9660::tmcl::AccelerationFFShift accelFFShift =
4408 config.accelerationFeedForwardShift.value_or(DEFAULT_ACCEL_FF_SHIFT);
4409
4410 ok &= enableFeedForward(enableVelFF, enableAccelFF, accelFFGain, accelFFShift);
4411
4412 // Step 6: Configure direct velocity mode
4413 constexpr bool DEFAULT_DIRECT_VEL_MODE = true;
4414 bool enableDirectVel = config.enableDirectVelocityMode.value_or(DEFAULT_DIRECT_VEL_MODE);
4415
4416 ok &= setDirectVelocityMode(enableDirectVel);
4417
4418 // Step 7: Enable/disable ramp generator (applied last)
4419 if (config.enableRamp.has_value()) {
4420 ok &= enable(config.enableRamp.value());
4421 }
4422
4423 return ok;
4424}

4426//***************************************************************************
4427//** SUBSYSTEM: Step/Dir Input Extrapolation **//
4428//***************************************************************************
4429
4430namespace detail {
4431// Capability gate for Step/Dir methods: NR 205..209 + VELOCITY_FEEDFORWARD_ENABLE all return
4432// REPLY_CMD_NOT_AVAILABLE when the bootloader has stepDir.enable=false. This helper logs once
4433// per blocked call and returns false so callers can short-circuit cleanly.
4434template <typename Driver>
4435inline bool tmc9660_require_step_dir(Driver& driver, const char* where) noexcept {
4436 if (driver.capabilities().stepDir) {
4437 return true;
4438 }
4439 driver.comm().logDebug(
4440 0, "TMC9660",
4441 "StepDir::%s: subsystem disabled — set BootloaderConfig.stepDir.enable=true "
4442 "(and re-run bootloader) to use Step/Dir input.",
4443 where);
4444 return false;
4445}
4446} // namespace detail
4447
4448template <typename CommType>
4449bool TMC9660<CommType>::StepDir::setMicrostepResolution(
4450 tmc9660::tmcl::StepDirStepDividerShift µSteps) noexcept {
4451 if (!detail::tmc9660_require_step_dir(driver, "setMicrostepResolution")) return false;
4452 return driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STEP_DIR_STEP_DIVIDER_SHIFT,
4453 static_cast<uint32_t>(µSteps));
4454}
4455
4456template <typename CommType>
4457bool TMC9660<CommType>::StepDir::enableInterface(bool on) noexcept {
4458 if (!detail::tmc9660_require_step_dir(driver, "enableInterface")) return false;
4459 return driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STEP_DIR_ENABLE, on ? 1u : 0u);
4460}

4463bool TMC9660<CommType>::StepDir::enableExtrapolation(bool enable) noexcept {
4464 if (!detail::tmc9660_require_step_dir(driver, "enableExtrapolation")) return false;
4465 return driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STEP_DIR_EXTRAPOLATION_ENABLE,
4466 enable ? 1u : 0u);
4467}

4574//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4575// Auto-Configuration
4576//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
4577
4578template <typename CommType>
4579bool TMC9660<CommType>::Brake::configureAuto(const BrakeConfig& config) noexcept {
4580 bool ok = true;
4581
4582 // Step 1: Configure brake chopper (if enabled)
4583 if (config.enableChopper.has_value() && config.enableChopper.value()) {
4584 ok &= enableChopper(true);
4585
4586 constexpr float DEFAULT_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_V = 30.0f; // Default for 24V systems
4587 constexpr float DEFAULT_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS_V = 2.0f;
4588
4589 float chopperVoltage = config.chopperVoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_CHOPPER_VOLTAGE_V);
4590 float chopperHyst = config.chopperHysteresis_V.value_or(DEFAULT_CHOPPER_HYSTERESIS_V);
4591
4592 // Clamp voltage to valid range [5.0-100.0V]
4593 if (chopperVoltage < 5.0f)
4594 chopperVoltage = 5.0f;
4595 if (chopperVoltage > 100.0f)
4596 chopperVoltage = 100.0f;
4597
4598 // Clamp hysteresis to valid range [0.0-5.0V]
4599 if (chopperHyst < 0.0f)
4600 chopperHyst = 0.0f;
4601 if (chopperHyst > 5.0f)
4602 chopperHyst = 5.0f;
4603
4604 ok &= setVoltageLimit(chopperVoltage);
4605 ok &= setHysteresis(chopperHyst);
4606 } else if (config.enableChopper.has_value() && !config.enableChopper.value()) {
4607 ok &= enableChopper(false);
4608 }
4609 // If enableChopper is not provided, leave chopper in current state
4610
4611 // Step 2: Configure mechanical brake parameters (if provided)
4612 // Note: Default values are currently unused but kept for future use
4613 // constexpr uint8_t DEFAULT_RELEASING_DUTY = 50;
4614 // constexpr uint8_t DEFAULT_HOLDING_DUTY = 30;
4615 // constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_RELEASING_DURATION_MS = 100;
4616 // constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_OUTPUT = false;
4617
4618 if (config.releasingDutyCycle.has_value()) {
4619 uint8_t duty = config.releasingDutyCycle.value();
4620 if (duty > 99)
4621 duty = 99; // Clamp to valid range
4622 ok &= setReleasingDutyCycle(duty);
4623 }
4624
4625 if (config.holdingDutyCycle.has_value()) {
4626 uint8_t duty = config.holdingDutyCycle.value();
4627 if (duty > 99)
4628 duty = 99; // Clamp to valid range
4629 ok &= setHoldingDutyCycle(duty);
4630 }
4631
4632 if (config.releasingDuration_ms.has_value()) {
4633 ok &= setReleasingDuration(config.releasingDuration_ms.value());
4634 }
4635
4636 if (config.invertOutput.has_value()) {
4637 ok &= invertOutput(config.invertOutput.value());
4638 }
4639
4640 return ok;
4641}

4646
4647template <typename CommType>
4648bool TMC9660<CommType>::IIT::configure(uint16_t timeConstant1_ms, float continuousCurrent1_A,
4649 uint16_t timeConstant2_ms, float continuousCurrent2_A) noexcept {
4650 bool ok = true;
4651 ok &= setThermalWindingTimeConstant1(timeConstant1_ms);
4652 const uint32_t limit1 =
4653 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent1_A * continuousCurrent1_A * timeConstant1_ms);
4654 ok &= setLimit1(limit1);
4655 ok &= setThermalWindingTimeConstant2(timeConstant2_ms);
4656 const uint32_t limit2 =
4657 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent2_A * continuousCurrent2_A * timeConstant2_ms);
4658 ok &= setLimit2(limit2);
4659 return ok;
4660}

4821//***************************************************************************
4822//** Motor context (chip-side facts) **//
4823//***************************************************************************
4824
4825template <typename CommType>
4826bool TMC9660<CommType>::getMotorContext(::tmc9660::units::MotorContext& ctx) noexcept {
4827 // Defaults — leave a usable context if any read fails.
4828 ctx = ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext{};
4829
4830 bool all_ok = true;
4831
4832 // Motor type (NR 8). Step/Dir-only firmware may NACK; not fatal.
4833 uint32_t mt = static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType::BLDC_MOTOR);
4834 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_TYPE, mt)) {
4835 ctx.motor_type = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::MotorType>(mt);
4836 } else {
4837 all_ok = false;
4838 }
4839
4840 // Pole pairs (NR 9). For steppers the bootloader writes
4841 // full_steps_per_rev/4 here, so the same field works for both motor types.
4842 uint32_t pp = 1;
4843 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS, pp)) {
4844 ctx.pole_pairs = static_cast<uint8_t>(pp == 0 ? 1u : pp);
4845 } else {
4846 all_ok = false;
4847 }
4848
4849 // Velocity sensor selection (NR 132).
4850 uint32_t vsel = static_cast<uint32_t>(
4851 tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::SAME_AS_COMMUTATION);
4852 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::VELOCITY_SENSOR_SELECTION, vsel)) {
4853 ctx.velocity_sensor = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection>(vsel);
4854 } else {
4855 all_ok = false;
4856 }
4857
4858 // Encoder CPR — only relevant when an encoder is selected for velocity.
4859 // NR 175 = ABN_1_STEPS, NR 178 = ABN_2_STEPS. SPI encoders' CPR is
4860 // configured at bootloader time; expose it via setMotorContextHint() if
4861 // the chip cannot self-report it.
4862 switch (ctx.velocity_sensor) {
4863 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN1_ENCODER: {
4864 uint32_t steps = 0;
4865 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ABN_1_STEPS, steps)) {
4866 ctx.encoder_cpr = steps;
4867 } else {
4868 all_ok = false;
4869 }
4870 break;
4871 }
4872 case tmc9660::tmcl::VelocitySensorSelection::ABN2_ENCODER: {
4873 uint32_t steps = 0;
4874 if (this->readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::ABN_2_STEPS, steps)) {
4875 ctx.encoder_cpr = steps;
4876 } else {
4877 all_ok = false;
4878 }
4879 break;
4880 }
4881 default:
4882 // SAME_AS_COMMUTATION / DIGITAL_HALL: CPR derived from pole pairs;
4883 // SPI_ENCODER: bootloader-side, leave at default unless caller hints.
4884 break;
4885 }
4886
4887 return all_ok;
4888}

4890//***************************************************************************
4891//** SUBSYSTEM: Diagnostics **//
4892//***************************************************************************
4893
4894template <typename CommType>
4895bool TMC9660<CommType>::Diagnostics::summary(
4896 ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSummary& out,
4897 ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext const& ctx) noexcept {
4898 out = ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSummary{};
4899
4900 // Bus / thermal — convenience getters always return a value (negative on error).
4901 out.vbus_volts = driver.telemetry.getSupplyVoltage();
4902 out.chip_temp_c = driver.telemetry.getChipTemperature();
4903
4904 // Mode
4905 uint32_t cm = 0;
4906 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::COMMUTATION_MODE, cm)) {
4907 out.commutation_mode = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode>(cm);
4908 out.valid_commutation_mode = true;
4909 }
4910
4911 // Velocity (target + actual)
4912 bool vel_ok = true;
4913 uint32_t tv = 0;
4914 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::TARGET_VELOCITY, tv)) {
4915 out.target_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
4916 static_cast<double>(static_cast<int32_t>(tv)),
4917 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
4918 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
4919 } else {
4920 vel_ok = false;
4921 }
4922 int32_t av = 0;
4923 if (driver.velocityControl.getActualVelocity(av)) {
4924 out.actual_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
4925 static_cast<double>(av),
4926 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
4927 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
4928 } else {
4929 vel_ok = false;
4930 }
4931 out.valid_velocity = vel_ok;
4932
4933 // Status / error registers
4934 uint32_t gen_status = 0, gen_err = 0, gd_err = 0, adc_err = 0;
4935 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags(gen_status);
4936 if (driver.telemetry.getGeneralErrorFlags(gen_err)) {
4937 out.general_error_flags = gen_err;
4938 out.has_general_error = (gen_err != 0u);
4939 }
4940 if (driver.telemetry.getGateDriverErrorFlags(gd_err)) {
4941 out.gate_driver_error_flags = gd_err;
4942 out.has_gate_driver_error = (gd_err != 0u);
4943 }
4944 if (driver.telemetry.getADCStatusFlags(adc_err)) {
4945 out.adc_status_flags = adc_err;
4946 out.has_adc_clipping = (adc_err != 0u);
4947 }
4948
4949 // Decode headline regulating bits (see GeneralStatusFlags FLAG layout).
4950 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationVelocityBit = 1u << 2;
4951 constexpr uint32_t kVelocityReachedBit = 1u << 10;
4952 out.regulating_velocity = (gen_status & kRegulationVelocityBit) != 0u;
4953 out.velocity_reached = (gen_status & kVelocityReachedBit) != 0u;
4954
4955 return true;
4956}
4957
4958template <typename CommType>
4959bool TMC9660<CommType>::Diagnostics::snapshot(
4960 ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSnapshot& out,
4961 ::tmc9660::units::MotorContext const& ctx) noexcept {
4962 out = ::tmc9660::diagnostics::MotorSnapshot{};
4963 out.context = ctx;
4964
4965 // Bus / thermal
4966 out.vbus_volts = driver.telemetry.getSupplyVoltage();
4967 out.chip_temp_c = driver.telemetry.getChipTemperature();
4968 out.external_temp_raw = driver.telemetry.getExternalTemperature();
4969
4970 // Mode
4971 uint32_t cm = 0;
4972 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::COMMUTATION_MODE, cm)) {
4973 out.commutation_mode = static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::CommutationMode>(cm);
4974 out.valid_commutation_mode = true;
4975 }
4976
4977 // Velocity (target / actual / ramp), in raw + RPM
4978 uint32_t tv = 0;
4979 if (driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::TARGET_VELOCITY, tv)) {
4980 out.target_velocity_internal = static_cast<int32_t>(tv);
4981 }
4982 int32_t av = 0;
4983 (void)driver.velocityControl.getActualVelocity(av);
4984 out.actual_velocity_internal = av;
4985 int32_t rv = 0;
4986 (void)driver.ramp.getRampVelocity(rv);
4987 out.ramp_velocity_internal = rv;
4988 out.target_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
4989 static_cast<double>(out.target_velocity_internal),
4990 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
4991 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
4992 out.actual_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
4993 static_cast<double>(out.actual_velocity_internal),
4994 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
4995 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
4996 out.ramp_velocity_rpm = ::tmc9660::units::convertVelocity(
4997 static_cast<double>(out.ramp_velocity_internal),
4998 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Internal,
4999 ::tmc9660::units::VelocityUnit::Rpm, ctx);
5000
5001 // Position
5002 int32_t p = 0;
5003 (void)driver.positionControl.getActualPosition(p);
5004 out.actual_position_counts = p;
5005 out.actual_position_revs = ::tmc9660::units::convertPosition(
5006 static_cast<double>(p), ::tmc9660::units::PositionUnit::Counts,
5007 ::tmc9660::units::PositionUnit::MechRevs, ctx);
5008 out.actual_position_deg_mech = out.actual_position_revs * 360.0;
5009
5010 // Electrical angle (PHI_E). Open-loop angle is the safest source while in
5011 // FOC_OPENLOOP_*; in sensored modes the chip mirrors active feedback there.
5012 int16_t phi = 0;
5013 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getOpenloopAngle(phi);
5014 out.phi_e_internal = phi;
5015 out.phi_e_deg_elec = ::tmc9660::units::convertAngle(
5016 static_cast<double>(phi), ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::PhiERaw,
5017 ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::DegElec, ctx);
5018 out.phi_e_deg_mech = ::tmc9660::units::convertAngle(
5019 static_cast<double>(phi), ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::PhiERaw,
5020 ::tmc9660::units::AngleUnit::DegMech, ctx);
5021
5022 // FOC currents / voltages (best-effort)
5023 out.motor_current_ma = driver.telemetry.getMotorCurrent();
5024 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentIq(out.iq_ma);
5025 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentUx(out.i_ux);
5026 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentV (out.i_v);
5027 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocCurrentWy(out.i_wy);
5028 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageUq(out.uq);
5029 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageUx(out.u_ux);
5030 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageV (out.u_v);
5031 (void)driver.torqueFluxControl.getFocVoltageWy(out.u_wy);
5032
5033 // Status / error registers
5034 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags (out.general_status_flags);
5035 (void)driver.telemetry.getGeneralErrorFlags (out.general_error_flags);
5036 (void)driver.telemetry.getGateDriverErrorFlags(out.gate_driver_error_flags);
5037 (void)driver.telemetry.getADCStatusFlags (out.adc_status_flags);
5038
5039 // Decode convenience bits (see GeneralStatusFlags FLAG layout).
5040 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationTorqueBit = 1u << 1;
5041 constexpr uint32_t kRegulationVelocityBit = 1u << 2;
5042 constexpr uint32_t kVelocityReachedBit = 1u << 10;
5043 out.regulating_torque = (out.general_status_flags & kRegulationTorqueBit) != 0u;
5044 out.regulating_velocity = (out.general_status_flags & kRegulationVelocityBit) != 0u;
5045 out.velocity_reached = (out.general_status_flags & kVelocityReachedBit) != 0u;
5046
5047 return true;
5048}

5050//***************************************************************************
5051//** SUBSYSTEM: Stop / Event **//
5052//***************************************************************************
5053
5054template <typename CommType>
5055bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::enableDeviationStop(uint32_t maxVelError, uint32_t maxPosError,
5056 bool softStop) noexcept {
5057 bool ok = true;
5058 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STOP_ON_VELOCITY_DEVIATION, maxVelError);
5059 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::STOP_ON_POSITION_DEVIATION, maxPosError);
5060
5061 using tmc9660::tmcl::EventStopSettings;
5062 bool vel = maxVelError != 0;
5063 bool pos = maxPosError != 0;
5064 EventStopSettings setting = EventStopSettings::DO_HARD_STOP;
5065 if (vel && pos)
5066 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_VEL_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5067 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_VEL_DEVIATION;
5068 else if (pos)
5069 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5070 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_POS_DEVIATION;
5071 else if (vel)
5072 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_VEL_DEVIATION_SOFT_STOP
5073 : EventStopSettings::STOP_ON_VEL_DEVIATION;
5074 else
5075 setting = softStop ? EventStopSettings::DO_SOFT_STOP : EventStopSettings::DO_HARD_STOP;
5076
5077 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::EVENT_STOP_SETTINGS,
5078 static_cast<uint32_t>(setting));
5079 return ok;
5080}
5081
5082template <typename CommType>
5083bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::configureReferenceSwitches(uint8_t mask, bool invertL, bool invertR,
5084 bool invertH, bool swapLR) noexcept {
5085 bool ok = true;
5086 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::REFERENCE_SWITCH_ENABLE, mask);
5087 uint8_t cfg =
5088 (invertL ? 1u : 0u) | (invertR ? 2u : 0u) | (invertH ? 4u : 0u) | (swapLR ? 8u : 0u);
5089 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::REFERENCE_SWITCH_POLARITY_AND_SWAP, cfg);
5090 return ok;
5091}
5092
5093template <typename CommType>
5094bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::getAndClearLatchedPosition(int32_t& pos) noexcept {
5095 uint32_t v;
5096 if (!driver.readParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::LATCH_POSITION, v))
5097 return false;
5098 pos = static_cast<int32_t>(v);
5099 return driver.writeParameter(
5100 tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::GENERAL_STATUS_FLAGS,
5101 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::RAMPER_LATCHED));
5102}
5103
5104//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5105// Auto-Configuration
5106//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5107
5108template <typename CommType>
5109bool TMC9660<CommType>::StopEvents::configureAuto(const StopEventsConfig& config) noexcept {
5110 bool ok = true;
5111
5112 // Step 1: Configure deviation stop (if enabled)
5113 if (config.maxVelocityDeviation.has_value() || config.maxPositionDeviation.has_value()) {
5114 constexpr bool DEFAULT_SOFT_STOP = true;
5115 uint32_t maxVelError = config.maxVelocityDeviation.value_or(0);
5116 uint32_t maxPosError = config.maxPositionDeviation.value_or(0);
5117 bool softStop = config.deviationSoftStop.value_or(DEFAULT_SOFT_STOP);
5118
5119 ok &= enableDeviationStop(maxVelError, maxPosError, softStop);
5120 }
5121
5122 // Step 2: Configure reference switches (if enabled)
5123 if (config.referenceSwitchMask.has_value()) {
5124 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_L = false;
5125 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_R = false;
5126 constexpr bool DEFAULT_INVERT_H = false;
5127 constexpr bool DEFAULT_SWAP_LR = false;
5128
5129 uint8_t mask = config.referenceSwitchMask.value();
5130 // Clamp mask to valid range [0-7]
5131 if (mask > 7)
5132 mask = 7;
5133
5134 bool invertL = config.invertLeftSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_L);
5135 bool invertR = config.invertRightSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_R);
5136 bool invertH = config.invertHomeSwitch.value_or(DEFAULT_INVERT_H);
5137 bool swapLR = config.swapLeftRight.value_or(DEFAULT_SWAP_LR);
5138
5139 ok &= configureReferenceSwitches(mask, invertL, invertR, invertH, swapLR);
5140 }
5141
5142 return ok;
5143}

5145//===========================================================================
5146//== SUBSYSTEM: Protection ==//
5147//===========================================================================
5148
5149template <typename CommType>
5150bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureVoltage(uint16_t overVoltThreshold,
5151 uint16_t underVoltThreshold) noexcept {
5152 bool ok = true;
5153 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_OVERVOLTAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5154 static_cast<uint32_t>(overVoltThreshold));
5155 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::SUPPLY_UNDERVOLTAGE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5156 static_cast<uint32_t>(underVoltThreshold));
5157 return ok;
5158}
5159
5160template <typename CommType>
5161bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureTemperature(float warningDegC, float shutdownDegC) noexcept {
5162 // Convert Celsius to raw sensor units: val = (Temp + 268.15) / 0.01615
5163 float warnVal = (warningDegC + 268.15f) / 0.01615f;
5164 float shutVal = (shutdownDegC + 268.15f) / 0.01615f;
5165 if (warnVal < 0)
5166 warnVal = 0;
5167 if (warnVal > 65535)
5168 warnVal = 65535;
5169 if (shutVal < 0)
5170 shutVal = 0;
5171 if (shutVal > 65535)
5172 shutVal = 65535;
5173 uint16_t warnRaw = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::lround(warnVal));
5174 uint16_t shutRaw = static_cast<uint16_t>(std::lround(shutVal));
5175 bool ok = true;
5176 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::CHIP_TEMPERATURE_WARNING_THRESHOLD,
5177 static_cast<uint32_t>(warnRaw));
5178 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::CHIP_TEMPERATURE_SHUTDOWN_THRESHOLD,
5179 static_cast<uint32_t>(shutRaw));
5180 return ok;
5181}
5182
5183template <typename CommType>
5184bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::setOvercurrentEnabled(bool enabled) noexcept {
5185 using tmc9660::tmcl::OvercurrentEnable;
5186 using tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters;
5187 const OvercurrentEnable temp =
5188 enabled ? OvercurrentEnable::ENABLED : OvercurrentEnable::DISABLED;
5189 const uint32_t v = static_cast<uint32_t>(temp);
5190 // All SAP (axis parameters). Full 4-phase path programs Y2; 3-phase BLDC stacks often omit Y2
5191 // and some firmware returns REPLY_WRONG_TYPE for Y2_* — UVW enables still apply.
5192 if (driver.gateDriver.enableOvercurrentProtection(temp, temp, temp, temp))
5193 return true;
5194 bool ok = true;
5195 ok &= driver.writeParameter(Parameters::UVW_LOW_SIDE_ENABLE, v);
5196 ok &= driver.writeParameter(Parameters::UVW_HIGH_SIDE_ENABLE, v);
5197 return ok;
5198}
5199
5200template <typename CommType>
5201bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureI2t(uint16_t timeConstant1_ms, float continuousCurrent1_A,
5202 uint16_t timeConstant2_ms,
5203 float continuousCurrent2_A) noexcept {
5204 bool ok = true;
5205 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_1,
5206 timeConstant1_ms);
5207 uint32_t limit1 =
5208 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent1_A * continuousCurrent1_A * timeConstant1_ms);
5209 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::IIT_LIMIT_1, limit1);
5210 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::THERMAL_WINDING_TIME_CONSTANT_2,
5211 timeConstant2_ms);
5212 uint32_t limit2 =
5213 static_cast<uint32_t>(continuousCurrent2_A * continuousCurrent2_A * timeConstant2_ms);
5214 ok &= driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::IIT_LIMIT_2, limit2);
5215 return ok;
5216}
5217
5218template <typename CommType>
5219bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::resetI2tState() noexcept {
5220 return driver.writeParameter(tmc9660::tmcl::Parameters::RESET_IIT_SUMS, 1u);
5221}

5223//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5224// Auto-Configuration
5225//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5226
5227template <typename CommType>
5228bool TMC9660<CommType>::Protection::configureAuto(const ProtectionConfig& config) noexcept {
5229 bool ok = true;
5230
5231 // Step 1: Configure voltage protection
5232 constexpr float DEFAULT_OVERVOLTAGE_V = 28.0f; // Default for 24V systems
5233 constexpr float DEFAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE_V = 20.0f; // Default for 24V systems
5234
5235 float overVolt = config.overvoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_OVERVOLTAGE_V);
5236 float underVolt = config.undervoltageThreshold_V.value_or(DEFAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE_V);
5237
5238 // Convert volts to 0.1V units (as required by configureVoltage)
5239 uint16_t overVoltThreshold = static_cast<uint16_t>(overVolt * 10.0f + 0.5f);
5240 uint16_t underVoltThreshold = static_cast<uint16_t>(underVolt * 10.0f + 0.5f);
5241
5242 if (config.program_supply_voltage_warnings) {
5243 ok &= configureVoltage(overVoltThreshold, underVoltThreshold);
5244 }
5245
5246 // Step 2: Configure temperature protection
5247 constexpr float DEFAULT_TEMP_WARNING_C = 80.0f;
5248 constexpr float DEFAULT_TEMP_SHUTDOWN_C = 100.0f;
5249
5250 float tempWarning = config.temperatureWarning_C.value_or(DEFAULT_TEMP_WARNING_C);
5251 float tempShutdown = config.temperatureShutdown_C.value_or(DEFAULT_TEMP_SHUTDOWN_C);
5252
5253 if (config.program_chip_temperature_warnings) {
5254 ok &= configureTemperature(tempWarning, tempShutdown);
5255 }
5256
5257 // Step 3: Configure overcurrent protection (gate-driver OC enable SAPs)
5258 if (config.program_gate_driver_overcurrent_enable) {
5259 constexpr bool DEFAULT_OVERCURRENT_ENABLED = true;
5260 bool enableOC = config.enableOvercurrent.value_or(DEFAULT_OVERCURRENT_ENABLED);
5261 ok &= setOvercurrentEnabled(enableOC);
5262 }
5263
5264 // Step 4: Configure I²t thermal protection
5265 if (config.program_i2t_limits) {
5266 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I2T_TIME1_MS = 100;
5267 constexpr float DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT1_A = 1.5f;
5268 constexpr uint16_t DEFAULT_I2T_TIME2_MS = 1000;
5269 constexpr float DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT2_A = 1.25f;
5270
5271 uint16_t time1 = config.i2tTimeConstant1_ms.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_TIME1_MS);
5272 float current1 = config.i2tContinuousCurrent1_A.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT1_A);
5273 uint16_t time2 = config.i2tTimeConstant2_ms.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_TIME2_MS);
5274 float current2 = config.i2tContinuousCurrent2_A.value_or(DEFAULT_I2T_CURRENT2_A);
5275
5276 ok &= configureI2t(time1, current1, time2, current2);
5277 }
5278
5279 return ok;
5280}

5282//===========================================================================
5283//== SUBSYSTEM: Script ==//
5284//===========================================================================
5285
5286template <typename CommType>
5287bool TMC9660<CommType>::Script::upload(const std::vector<uint32_t>& scriptData) noexcept {
5288 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::DownloadStart, 0, 0, 0, nullptr))
5289 return false;
5290
5291 // During download mode, scriptData contains packed TMCL operations
5292 // Each uint32_t represents one TMCL operation: [opcode, type, motor, value]
5293 // These operations will be stored to script memory instead of executed
5294 for (uint32_t packedOp : scriptData) {
5295 // Extract TMCL operation components from packed data
5296 uint8_t opcode = (packedOp >> 24) & 0xFF;
5297 uint8_t type = (packedOp >> 16) & 0xFF;
5298 uint8_t motor = (packedOp >> 8) & 0xFF;
5299 uint8_t value = packedOp & 0xFF;
5300
5301 // Send the TMCL operation - it will be stored to script memory during download mode
5302 if (!driver.sendCommand(static_cast<tmc9660::tmcl::Op>(opcode), type, motor, value, nullptr))
5303 return false;
5304 }
5305
5306 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::DownloadEnd, 0, 0, 0, nullptr);
5307}

5400//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5401// NvmStorage helpers
5402//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
5403
5404template <typename CommType>
5405bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::storeToFlash() noexcept {
5406 // Use STAP command with fixed fields as documented in the TMCL manual
5407 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::STAP, 0x0FFF, 0x0F, 0xFFFFFFFF, nullptr);
5408}
5409
5410template <typename CommType>
5411bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::recallFromFlash() noexcept {
5412 // Trigger a configuration reload from external memory using FactoryDefault
5413 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::FactoryDefault, 0, 0, 0, nullptr))
5414 return false;
5415 // Give the controller some time to process and then check status flag
5416 comm_.delayMs(50);
5417 uint32_t flags = 0;
5418 if (!driver.telemetry.getGeneralStatusFlags(flags))
5419 return false;
5420 constexpr uint32_t CONFIG_LOADED_MASK =
5421 static_cast<uint32_t>(tmc9660::tmcl::GeneralStatusFlags::CONFIG_LOADED);
5422 return (flags & CONFIG_LOADED_MASK) != 0;
5423}
5424
5425template <typename CommType>
5426bool TMC9660<CommType>::NvmStorage::eraseFlashBank(uint8_t n) noexcept {
5427 // Erase specified flash bank via FactoryDefault with type field as bank index
5428 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::FactoryDefault, n, 0, 0, nullptr);
5429}

5447template <typename CommType>
5448bool TMC9660<CommType>::Heartbeat::configureAuto(const HeartbeatConfig& config) noexcept {
5449 constexpr bool DEFAULT_ENABLE = false;
5450 constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1000;
5451
5452 bool enable = config.enable.value_or(DEFAULT_ENABLE);
5453 uint32_t timeout = config.timeoutMs.value_or(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS);
5454
5455 // HeartbeatMonitoringConfig: DISABLED, TMCL_UART_INTERFACE, SPI_INTERFACE
5456 // For simple enable/disable, use TMCL_UART_INTERFACE when enabled (most common)
5457 tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig mode =
5458 enable ? tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig::TMCL_UART_INTERFACE
5459 : tmc9660::tmcl::HeartbeatMonitoringConfig::DISABLED;
5460
5461 return configure(mode, timeout);
5462}

5678//***************************************************************************
5679//** SUBSYSTEM: General-purpose GPIO (Digital/Analog I/O) **//
5680//***************************************************************************
5681template <typename CommType>
5682bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::setMode(uint8_t pin, bool output, bool pullEnable, bool pullUp) noexcept {
5683 if (pin > 18)
5684 return false;
5685 uint32_t bit = 1u << pin;
5686 uint32_t mask;
5687 bool ok = driver.globals.getIODirectionMask(mask);
5688 if (!ok)
5689 return false;
5690 mask = output ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
5691 ok &= driver.globals.setIODirectionMask(mask);
5692
5693 ok &= driver.globals.getPullEnableMask(mask);
5694 if (!ok)
5695 return false;
5696 mask = pullEnable ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
5697 ok &= driver.globals.setPullEnableMask(mask);
5698
5699 ok &= driver.globals.getPullDirectionMask(mask);
5700 if (!ok)
5701 return false;
5702 mask = pullUp ? (mask | bit) : (mask & ~bit);
5703 ok &= driver.globals.setPullDirectionMask(mask);
5704 return ok;
5705}
5706template <typename CommType>
5707bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::writePin(uint8_t pin, bool value) noexcept {
5708 if (pin > 18)
5709 return false;
5710 return driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::SIO, pin, 0, value ? 1u : 0u, nullptr);
5711}
5712template <typename CommType>
5713bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::readDigital(uint8_t pin, bool& value) noexcept {
5714 if (pin > 18)
5715 return false;
5716 uint32_t v;
5717 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GIO, pin, 0, 0, &v))
5718 return false;
5719 value = (v != 0);
5720 return true;
5721}
5722template <typename CommType>
5723bool TMC9660<CommType>::GPIO::readAnalog(uint8_t pin, uint16_t& value) noexcept {
5724 if (pin > 18)
5725 return false;
5726 uint32_t v;
5727 if (!driver.sendCommand(tmc9660::tmcl::Op::GIO, pin, 1, 0, &v))
5728 return false;
5729 value = static_cast<uint16_t>(v);
5730 return true;
5731}

5743//=============================================================================

5745//=============================================================================
5746// Explicit template instantiations for ESP32 communication interfaces.
5747// These instantiations allow the template implementations to remain in .cpp
5748// files while still being usable by the ESP32 examples.
5749//
5750// Note: To use other communication interfaces, either:
5751// 1. Add explicit instantiations here, OR
5752// 2. Move template implementations to header files (inline)
5753//=============================================================================
5754
5755// Forward declarations for ESP32 types (defined in examples)
5756// These are only needed if building examples, otherwise the instantiations
5757// will be skipped by the linker if unused.
5758#ifdef ESP_PLATFORM
5759// ESP32 types are defined in examples/esp32/main/esp32_tmc9660_bus.hpp
5760// We can't include it here as it would create a circular dependency.
5761// Instead, explicit instantiations should be in a separate file or
5762// the examples should include the implementation.
5763//
5764// For now, we'll use a different approach: move implementations to headers
5765// OR create explicit instantiation file in examples directory.
5766#endif
5767
5768#endif // TMC9660_IMPL
